launches.title: FinalDose: The first programmable drug to cure all cancers
launches.tagline: FinalDose is building the first programmable drug platform - a single smart drug molecule that finds diseased cells by their DNA and destroys them. We’re starting with all cancers.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

**For 60 years, drug discovery has chased proteins. But \~85% of disease drivers don't have a druggable protein, making them unreachable for modern medicine. The deeper issue: most disease doesn't start at the protein, it starts in the DNA that codes for it. We built a programmable drug that reads DNA inside the cell, decides if it's diseased, and destroys the cell if it is. One platform, reprogrammed to any disease distinguishable on a DNA level.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101229&key=user_uploads/2957085/2cb08187-4767-47e6-845e-1adc642aec61)

[Check us out](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=446etIvaYCM&t=2s)

**❌ The Problem**

Drug discovery hasn't really changed in sixty years. Pick a protein, throw millions of molecules at it, spaghetti at a wall, hoping something sticks. 10 years and $2.6B per drug.

The bigger issue is proteins aren't where most disease starts. Disease starts in the DNA. The protein is downstream - the symptom, not the cause. Which is why \~85% of validated disease drivers have no druggable protein at all. Cancers driven by MYC, TP53, APC; Viral reservoir; clonal populations that drive systematic risk. All "undruggable" with the old protein playbook.

**✨ Our Solution**

We went straight for the DNA.

We started with a DNA-sensing protein that undergoes a sharp structural change when it finds its target sequence. We hijacked that structure change and turned it into a kill switch:

1\. The molecule scans the genome for a hardcoded target sequence.

2\. When it finds the target sequence, our drug changes in structure

3\. The structural change triggers a kill switch

4\. The diseased cell containing the target DNA dies. Neighboring healthy cells are untouched.

Same molecular  molecule, new guide → new drug. This means R&D cycle and cost collapses to near 0.

The compounding asset: we already have decades of human genetics telling us which sequences cause which disease. We're not searching for new biology - we're turning genetics that's already in the textbooks into drugs.

**⚙️ Our Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/854295/ab013db6-2afe-4d60-a0b6-88a575695993)

(Left) **Jeff Liu - CEO**. Oxford PhD in Oncology. Previous startup (Vivid Dx) solved a multi-decade bottleneck in sepsis diagnostics: low biomass isolation. By overcoming this hurdle, we built the world’s fastest diagnostic system - slashing wait times from 5 days to just 30 minutes. Track record of closing institutional rounds - $5M seed and a $10M Pre-Series A.

(Middle) **Li-Yao Huang - CSO**. Oxford PhD in Biochemistry. Developed a comprehensive discovery-to-validation framework utilizing Cas9 and its derivatives to identify and verify novel therapeutic targets from high-throughput genetic-genetic and genetic-drug interaction data. Scientific lead in molecular biology, cellular assays, construct engineering.

(Right) **Steven Lin - CTO**. Oxford PhD in Computational Biology. Previously Data Lead at Gutsee Biotech. Developed novel machine learning method to use coevolution biology to identify genetic targets that convey drug resistance in viruses. During SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, led UK biobank analysis of human genetics susceptibility for infections

This will be the most general curative modality for any genetic mutation driven disease ever. Love to chat!

Find us at [founders@finaldose.ai](mailto:founders@finaldose.ai)

launches.title: Superlog: The self-installing observability tool that fixes your bugs
launches.tagline: A wizard sets up your telemetry every day. An agent investigates incidents and ships mergeable PRs.
launches.body:
Hey YC! We're Nicolò and Arseniy, co-founders of Superlog ([superlog.sh](https://superlog.sh/)).

**TL;DR:** Superlog is the observability tool you're not supposed to open. A wizard scans your repo and instruments it with OpenTelemetry, and re-runs daily to keep your logs, alerts, and dashboards in sync with your code. When something breaks, an agent investigates with full context and posts one mergeable PR per incident into Slack.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AeX3pnHCMHg>

## **The Problem**

Arseniy spent years at Datadog, getting paged during the night to debug production incidents. In our first startups, we tried Sentry, Datadog, Grafana, Dash0, and nothing was good enough. 

* **Setup never ends.** Proper telemetry takes days of manual work and breaks the moment you ship new features. Half the dashboards end up empty or outdated.
* **Alert fatigue is constant.** Sentry floods Slack with duplicates and no context. The Saturday #ops ping is the worst feeling of the week.
* **The bill climbs.** Datadog invoices keep growing while engineers still spend hours configuring dashboards, chasing three AWS metrics that disagree, and copy-pasting stack traces into Claude at 11pm.

## **Our Solution**

**1. Telemetry that sets itself up.** Tell your agent:

```
Run npx skills add superloglabs/skills --all and use the skills to install Superlog in this project
```

This skill instruments your code with native OTel SDKs: proper semantic conventions, service and environment tagging. We cover all failure modes, endpoint performance, usage per tenant, and LLM/upstream cost (by callsite, tenant, and model). We run observability check-ins that keep adding logs, alerts, and dashboards as your code grows.

**2. An agent that investigates and ships PRs.** Errors get prioritised and grouped into incidents. The agent investigates with full context (logs, traces, metrics, recent deploys) and either produces a short tested PR, or posts its findings and pulls in the engineers who own the system (based on docs, prior investigations, Slack threads). One mergeable PR per incident in Slack. Merge it, ignore it, or open it as a Claude Code/Codex session and tweak.

**3. No alert fatigue.** Our custom eval setup makes sure incident summaries in your #ops channel are dense and correct, with severity and impact upfront. Every LLM-enhanced metric ships with a confidence score, so wrong guesses don't get boosted.

The telemetry you get is vendor-neutral: you keep all the OTel logs, metrics, and traces we install, even if you choose to switch providers.

## **Where We're Going**

Every engineering team in the world burns nights and weekends debugging production. We want to delete that loop. Observability should install itself, alert intelligently, and fix what it can.

## **About Us**

* **Nicolò (CEO)** — ex-BCG, math olympiad winner, scaled two startups to millions in ARR, with international enterprise contracts at Bluco (McDonald’s, Volkswagen, Dufry, etc).
* **Arseniy (CTO)** — coding since 12yo, won school olympiads, worked on high-performance data systems at Datadog and built engineering teams from scratch at Bluco.

launches.title: Rudus: AI-powered takeoff for concrete subcontractors
launches.tagline: Rudus helps concrete contractors produce quotes 80% faster
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Rudus is an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform built for concrete subcontractors. Takeoff is the process of measuring and quantifying materials from concrete plan sheets. Rudus identifies every concrete structure (footings, walls, columns, slabs), pulls in related details, and eliminates hours of manual quantity calculation.

**Ask:** If you know anyone in construction, we would greatly appreciate a warm introduction. Concrete-specific would be even more amazing. We would also love to talk to anyone who has built computer vision models.

**Launch video**\
<<https://youtu.be/QdXKLNN4IQo> >

**The problem:**

Concrete subcontractors are the backbone of every building, and their estimating workflow hasn't changed in 20 years . A senior estimator opens a PDF, manually traces every footing and grade beam, then hand-builds an Excel spreadsheet with 300+ line items- volumes, formwork, rebar by bar size with lap splices and development lengths. One bid takes 20 to 40 hours. Most firms have just a few estimators. That means they physically cannot bid on most of the work available to them. 

The software incumbent in this trade hasn’t been updated since 2020. Past that, every AI takeoff tool on the market was built for GCs and treats concrete as one checkbox. None of them expand rebar assemblies. None of them compute development lengths. None of them output quantities the way a concrete estimator actually prices work. We built Rudus for this trade and only this trade. 

**Solution**

An estimator uploads their structural PDFs. Rudus auto-classifies every sheet (foundation plans, section details, footing schedules, frame elevations) and routes each to the right processing pipeline. Computer vision detects concrete elements across the drawing set and follows cross-references across sheets to resolve dimensions and detailing, catching elements that plan-only tools always miss. Each element gets expanded into full assembly line items: concrete, formwork, and rebar with all the calcs an estimator would normally do by hand. A typical foundation package goes from a handful of assemblies to 80-120 priced line items. The estimator reviews, overrides where needed, and exports straight into their existing workflow. We cut takeoff time by 80% and help estimators bid 3-5× more projects without adding headcount. From plan upload to bid package, every part of the workflow gets faster. 

**How we got here**

Sahil and I were engineers at Amazon and Airbnb respectively. We are both from Cupertino, CA and have been best friends since high school, always talking of starting a company together. Sahil took a construction management class and realized estimation workflows hadn't changed in decades. We started cold calling, walking into offices, showing up at job sites, and everyone told us the same thing: slow estimation is the biggest bottleneck in their business, but every new product they've tried has failed. We quickly realized that the reason those tools failed is a lack of trust. Estimators stake million to billion dollar bids on these numbers, and they won't trade their workflow for a black box. We took a different approach: software that accelerates their current workflows rather than replacing it by forward deploying our product into their current estimation workflow. The response from the industry was overwhelmingly positive, and we now ship weekly to estimators with decades of experience. They keep asking for more.

launches.title: Aseon Labs: robotic pitstops for self-driving cars
launches.tagline: A depot in-a-box for charging, cleaning & inspecting autonomous fleets
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Autonomous vehicles still rely on centralized, human-operated depots for daily charging, cleaning and servicing. Aseon builds robotic pitstops that let AV fleets reset directly inside the city, reducing downtime, dead miles and operating cost.

<https://youtu.be/4lFZU9pY1gM>

## **❌ The problem**

Autonomous driving is working. The operational layer around it is not.

Today, autonomous vehicles regularly leave high-demand zones up to 3 times per day just to charge, clean and get inspected.

Most fleets still rely on large, remote, human-operated centralized depots.

That means:

* 10–15 mile roundtrips just to reset vehicles
* vehicles out of operation for hours
* up to 44% of vehicle time spent driving empty
* as many as 1 in 3 vehicles unavailable during peak demand
* reset costs that can exceed $100 per cycle

For autonomous fleets, uptime is revenue. But today’s operating model still looks like traditional depot logistics.

## **✅ What we built**

We believe autonomous vehicles need autonomous operations, always available and distributed across the centre of the city.

So we built the Aseon pod: **a robotic pitstop station that bundles high-frequency depot workflows into a compact, rapidly deployable pod.**

Aseon Pods allow fleets to:

* charge vehicles near demand
* automatically clean interiors & exteriors
* run inspection workflows between rides
* access a reset within max. 2 miles of a vehicle’s location

Compared to traditional depot operations, Aseon can:

* reduce reset cost by up to 50%
* reduce time out of service by up to 65%
* increase revenue per vehicle by $50k+ per year

Aseon Labs is building a new category of infrastructure for autonomous fleets: robotic pitstops deployed directly where vehicles operate.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101210&key=user_uploads/180428/dacbddc1-d989-4d47-94b1-37c323826394)

## **🧩 Why us**

We’re second-time founders, building together for the second time.

Our previous company, Pushme, became the world’s largest battery-swap network for shared e-scooters and e-bikes, across 5,000 locations in 40 cities before being acquired by TIER-Dott ($600M raised).

Before Aseon:

**George Kalligeros** led TIER’s 100-person hardware organization and deployed $300M+ in fleet hardware as VP Hardware; was a mechanical engineer at Tesla.

**Dan Keene** scaled TIER energy network to 5k locations. He later served as CBO at Superduper ($4B infra). Prior to that he led 20 markets at Deliveroo (DoorDash) and worked in M&A.

launches.title: Lumius — The 3D Camera for the Body
launches.tagline: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound for everyone
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Lumius is making real-time, accessible, and intelligent 3D ultrasound to advance beyond today’s widely used 2D ultrasound (500 million scans annually). Our vision is to make 3D ultrasound a universal camera for the body.

<https://youtu.be/bWlJD4_Bx4k>

**Backstory**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101060&key=user_uploads/3059826/d6bfe836-eb86-43cf-af8f-cf653183cebc)

Luca Menozzi, Chenhang Li, and I bonded over ultrasound during our PhDs at Duke. For years, it has bothered us that ultrasound looks largely the same as it did decades ago. It is safer and more accessible than imaging tools like PET, CT, or MRI, yet it has never quite become as widely used in everyday care as it should be.

**The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101060&key=user_uploads/3059826/a37bfe1d-0a2f-4738-ac51-c7628335098e)

The vast majority of ultrasound imaging today is still 2D. Clinicians have to maneuver a probe while mentally reconstructing 3D anatomy from flat images. That makes ultrasound hard to learn and difficult to use, especially for newer clinicians.  3D ultrasound does exist today, mainly for cardiac and fetal imaging, but current systems cost roughly 10x more than standard 2D ultrasound machines.

**The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101060&key=user_uploads/3059826/63de8f91-ad1d-4cd2-abdc-cbd2461fcd5f)

Our tech shows a clear on-the-fly 3D view of what's inside the body with AI assistance. Instead of relying on thin 2D slices, users see the full volume in context, eliminating the 2D guesswork that makes ultrasound difficult to use. 

Our device will be affordable, compact, and portable. AI integration will also make it context-aware and intelligent, guiding users by explaining what they’re seeing and what to do next. For example, automatically detecting and extracting blood vessels, nerves, muscle, and more. 

We're starting with vascular access, particularly central line placement. This is a procedure where \~50% of first attempts fail, especially among new clinicians. And hospitals spend millions each year training clinicians on 2D ultrasound. From there, we will expand to blood clot detection, nerve block imaging, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is to make 3D ultrasound a universal camera for the body, accessible to everyone. 

**Our Asks**

We'd love to hear from:

* **Clinicians and hospital innovation teams** dealing with vascular access, nerve blocks, and/or ultrasound-guided procedures
* **Med device innovators** or anyone in the healthcare/medtech space that are interested in 3D imaging guidance
* **Anyone with feedback** on medical imaging, hardware, or FDA pathways

Please reach out to us at [contact@lumius-imaging.com](mailto:contact@lumius-imaging.com) or [book a quick call](https://calendly.com/contact-lumius-imaging/30min)

Sources: <https://bjcardio.co.uk/2008/01/ultrasound-guided-central-venous-access/> <https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/Rapid-Femoral-Vein-Assessment-(RaFeVA)%3A-A-protocol-Brescia-Pittiruti/fade5949934e6e5a0fdaa8e798d5bf89934f9c50/figure/8> <https://academic.oup.com/academicmedicine/article-abstract/85/9/1462/8353240>

Meru Health is a precision, whole-person mental healthcare company. Today we launched **Meru Health Advanced** — a 6 to 12 month integrated psychiatry and therapy program for the patients standard care has failed most completely: treatment-resistant depression and anxiety, severe mental illness, and mental health stacked on chronic physical illness.

Every patient starts with a real diagnosis: comprehensive psychiatric visits, a 30–50 biomarker lab panel, and a coordinated team — psychiatrist, therapist, dietitian, care navigator — on one platform. Plus continuous biometric data via Whoop, HRV biofeedback, and lab-informed lifestyle and supplement protocols.

Across 17 peer-reviewed studies (Stanford, Harvard, UCSF, UC Davis, Washington, Rutgers), 55–67% of our patients achieve a 50%+ reduction in depression symptoms in 2–3 months — vs 19–33% on SSRIs. Accorded actuarial analysis: 55% fewer inpatient admissions, 31% fewer ER visits, 23% lower Rx costs.

<https://youtu.be/KFnCtezutDo>

## **What's the backstory?**

Kristian and his co-founders Riku and Albert founded Meru after Kristian had lost his brother Peter to suicide. Standard psychiatry couldn't help him; the antidepressants he was prescribed only made him worse. He wasn't an outlier — 30–40% of people with mental health conditions get labeled "treatment-resistant," a phrase I read as a confession that the model itself runs out of options after the second or third prescription.

A decade and 45,000 patients in, our 12-week Therapy program is enough for most. But the most complex patients needed something more: a psychiatrist who understands metabolic and lifestyle medicine, comprehensive labs, a dietitian, and a team that operates as one. That combination didn't exist anywhere. So we built it.

## **What are your asks?**

**1. Patient intros** — anyone who's tried the standard path and not gotten better, especially treatment-resistant and severe conditions, or mental health on a chronic illness. <https://www.meruhealth.com/advanced>

launches.title: Clawvisor — The Authorization Layer for AI Agents
launches.tagline: Give agents access without giving them the keys.
launches.body:
TL;DR: Clawvisor lets AI agents use apps like Gmail, Slack, and Google Drive without going rogue or ever seeing your credentials. You approve tasks once. Clawvisor enforces them on every request.

[_Launch video_](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2UWv557dg6M)

We're at the start of something on the scale of the industrial revolution. Agents will draft our emails, run our reports, manage our calendars, ship our code. A single person with a capable agent can get done in an afternoon what used to take a team a week. The leverage is almost unlimited.

But outside of coding agents, few people are actually using them, at least not for anything that matters. We’ve seen what can go wrong. Mass-deleted inboxes, dropped production databases, sent emails that can't be undone. It's what happens when a long-running agent's instructions drift and it starts going rogue with hallucinated goals. The blast radius is whatever permissions you gave it, and granting access to "delete emails" covers both cleaning up spam and wiping your entire inbox. If you work in a regulated industry, at a security-conscious company, or you’re paying attention, agents are off the table.

We need a way to bring agents to the world safely. Something that lets you point one at your actual inbox, your actual calendar, your actual codebase, and trust it to do the work without trusting it with the keys. The capability is already here. We just have to make it safe to use.

That’s why I built Clawvisor.

**The Problem**

* OAuth scopes are too coarse for nondeterministic agents. "Read access" means both "triage recently received emails" and "exfiltrate an archive of the whole inbox".
* Approving every action causes fatigue. You stop reading and start blindly clicking “approve”.
* Credentials end up everywhere. API keys scattered across .env files, config directories, messaging apps.
* Today’s default approach is basically YOLO.

**The Solution**

Clawvisor sits between your agent and your data. You ask your agent to do work. Your agent declares a task. You approve it once. Clawvisor enforces it on every request.

* No credential exposure. Keys stay in a vault. The agent never sees them.
* Real-time policy enforcement. Requests that don’t match the task get blocked.
* Context-aware guardrails. Agents can only act on data they actually retrieved.
* Full audit trail. Every action and decision is logged.

For example, if you approve an agent to “check today’s calendar” and it tries to pull 5 years of events? Blocked.

Approvals happen per task, not per action, so you avoid fatigue. Each task is also scored for risk, so you know when to pay extra attention.

It’s agent-agnostic by design. If your agent can talk HTTP, it can use Clawvisor. OpenClaw, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Hermes, Perplexity Computer are all supported. BYOA.

[_Demo video_](https://youtu.be/83oP_vOmpBk)

**The Team**

Previously I cofounded Berbix (S18, acquired for $70M in 2023) building best-in-class identity verification. Prior to that, I led the Airbnb Trust & Safety engineering team building systems and tools to catch bad actors before they could cause damage.

launches.tagline: Staging environment for enterprise AI agents
launches.body:
TLDR; 

**Chronicle Labs is a staging environment for enterprise AI agents: we capture every event the agent sees in production and replay it, so customers can deploy new behaviors quickly without breaking anything.** 

<https://youtu.be/LdpAPgGYL1E>

Hello Bookface! My name is Ayman, and I’m the CEO of Chronicle Labs.

For the past 10 years, I’ve been building autonomous systems. I’ve had the chance to work on the Mars Rovers and the James Webb Space Telescope at NASA JPL, and throughout my career, I’ve been able to build autonomous systems from day one without ever having to physically touch the robots,  thanks to the power of logs that replay state like a time machine.

Think tools like [Rerun.io](http://Rerun.io) or ROS bags. These tools are incredibly powerful because they capture the full state of a robotic system at a slice in time, which can then be replayed down to the microsecond to understand what actually happened.

AI agents are the autonomous systems of businesses.

But if you want to develop an AI agent for your business, it’s rare to have a structured slice of logs that you can replay to prove your agent will actually work. Teams can vibe-deploy, but testing on your users is a bad idea, especially for enterprises that are risk-averse.

Today, most teams try to solve this by hand-building evals. That works for a bit, but it doesn’t scale, and honestly I’ve seen many teams skip evals entirely. More importantly, as your business grows, your operations keep changing. Small nuances, edge cases, and workflow drift will always start to trend away from a static eval set.

My co-founder [@Rowan Zyadeh](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1599381) and I built Chronicle to give teams the ability to backtest their agents against their actual operational reality. Chronicle takes your existing operational history and turns it into seeded sandboxes with scenarios based on how your business really works.

Book a demo: <https://chronicle-labs.com/book-call>

If you’re building agents and you’re sick of vibe-deploying, or you feel like your eval suite is lacking, we want to talk to you.

launches.title: Light Anchor, AI-run consumer brands
launches.tagline: Building fully AI-run consumer brands at the speed of compute
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** 

Light Anchor (YC P26) builds fully autonomous e-commerce brands that run at the speed of compute. Consumer brands have always been limited by the speed of humans: hiring, coordinating, and sleeping. AI agents that now run operations end-to-end break all those constraints, making a new kind of consumer business possible: one capped by compute, not headcount.

Today, Light Anchor operates one flagship brand and multiple experiment stores, all run by AI agents on a shared platform that compounds with every new brand launched. The vision is thousands of consumer businesses, operating with little to no human intervention.

<https://youtu.be/_uN-A-4uugA>

### **Why we're doing this**

E-commerce brands have always been bottlenecked by how fast humans can run them. With agents that operate end-to-end, that bottleneck disappears, and a different kind of consumer business becomes possible: one where the cost and speed of operating it isn't capped by headcount.

To test whether agents could do the actual work humans do at an e-commerce brand, we deployed our first agent on Upwork, where small businesses post tasks for freelancers. We started small, with discrete tasks: catalog cleanup, SKU uploads, and data migrations. Within days, our agent had completed 50+ Shopify jobs end-to-end at a 4.9/5 rating, and the same clients started asking for more. "Clean up our catalog" turned into "run our marketing," then "handle our sourcing," then "run the whole storefront." Within 3 weeks, we were running multiple stores end-to-end for owners who used to do this work themselves.

Today we own and operate multiple stores of our own.

### **The agents, platform, and data**

Here are the agents that run our stores:

* **CEO agent**: sets weekly priorities, manages a $10K budget per brand, escalates decisions for human review
* **GM agent**: P&L, merchandising, inventory, sourcing, customer support
* **Marketing agent** ([cherylkim.me](http://cherylkim.me)): creatives and influencer marketing
* **Engineering agent**: unblocks technical work, ships tools

Every brand runs on the same architecture, with a shared layer (agent tooling, integrations, analytics) and a brand-specific layer (memory, policies, and decisions). Both compound: every brand we launch makes the platform smarter, and the marginal cost of launching the next brand keeps falling. Our bet isn't just to operate more stores; it's to understand customers better than any human team can and capture demand the moment it shifts.

Each brand generates a stream of operating decisions (creatives tested, ads spent, suppliers negotiated, tickets closed) that gets written to a central record the agents can read back from.

Humans don’t operate this way because the cost of writing everything down and coordinating across teams is higher than the value. When the operators are agents, that cost goes to zero. Once the record accumulates, a few things become possible: better targeting, faster store setup, and market/consumer simulations.

### **Asks**

If you're any of the following, or you know someone who is, we'd love to hear from you:

* **Buy our products:** Use the YC code YC26 for 25% discount at[ ](http://slowhaste.com)<https://seouldispatch.com/>. Every sale matters!
* **E-commerce owners:** Share your stories and experiences with us. We're happy to learn.
* **Signup for AdBench**: We’re benchmarking how marketing agents run ads across the latest frontier models. Sign up here: <https://www.lightanchor.ai/adbench>.
* **Frontier labs**: We want to learn how to use models better to operate businesses!

Reach us at [founders@lightanchor.ai](mailto:founders@lightanchor.ai).

### **Team**

We met at Sendbird (YC W16), where we led the AI agent product and forward deployment teams (respectively) during its 2024 pivot into AI agents for customer experience. Sendbird built the messaging APIs behind DoorDash, Reddit, and Hinge.

We took this right after we decided to start a company back in December. Day 1.

**AI adoption** is giving employees better tools: ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, internal assistants.

That can make individuals faster. But the company itself often stays the same: same workflows, same meetings, same approval chains, same bottlenecks.

**AI transformation** is different. It means redesigning how work happens around what AI now makes possible.

The problem is that this transformation is broad, fast-moving, and continuous. It touches **every function, every workflow, and every role**, while tools and capabilities keep evolving.

**Traditional methods cannot keep up.** Workshops, consulting projects, and static roadmaps are too slow, too generic, and too disconnected from day-to-day operations.

Foaster combines AI agents and human experts to help companies make AI transformation scalable, continuous, and personalized.

Agents handle the scale, follow-up, and personalization while human experts bring judgment, expertise, change management, and implementation support when needed.

launches.tagline: Ardent lets engineers give their coding agents 1:1 clones of prod to test code and prevent downtime
launches.body:
Hi! I’m Vikram founder of [@Ardent](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/31475). **We let you clone any postgres DB in <6s** so your coding agents and devs can test code on a 1:1 of production or dev DBs with zero risk

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100815&key=user_uploads/1239054/b0ebde7f-0ac7-49a9-8f42-e4fb3f26d585)

We’re working with companies with huge amounts of data like Supermemory and YC companies like [@Surface Labs](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/28921)

**This is me cloning a 1.6TB db is 6s:**

<https://youtu.be/8Q4IX7HUJmo>

Website: <https://tryardent.com/>

**How did we get here (the problem)?**

Ardent was a reaction to the failure of our last product - an AI Data Engineer. It was a coding agent that generated data pipelines, wrote migrations, backfills and other things you’d expect of a data engineer.

While the code _looked_ great we had no way of testing generated code. Writing to prod was out of the question and dev environments were never in sync, shared amongst devs which caused write clashes between agents, and was a huge pain to manage. **_What we needed was a ephemeral DB sandbox per agent of the user’s DB._**

Because of how hard testing was, generated code would never be tested and was too unstable to put in production. Database failures almost always mean downtime, a risk both we and customers were obviously not willing to take. We churned almost 200K in ARR

This problem exists with any coding agent today. We’re shipping 100x more DB code to production and we mostly just hope to god it works the same as dev.

**Ardent - Isolated <6s database clones that let you test agent code:**

Ardent solves the DB sandbox problem by letting you create 6s clones of ANY postgres DB regardless of size, allowing you to give every developer and every agent a full copy of production or dev to test against.

Clones autoscale to zero when not in use, use copy on write for massive storage efficiency and can be loaded with a single CLI command (zero infra management)

You can see the exact results of any code run against the DB in a perfect 1:1 reproduction and don’t have to change your DB provider.

The entire thing runs as a CLI that feels exactly like git. Cloning is as simple as “ardent branch create <name>”

This means you can spin up instant environments to test _every_ line of DB code with none of the overhead

**Asks**

**Use Ardent at your company to go faster by let agents work safely at the DB layer and prevent regressions:** <https://cal.com/vikram-chennai/yc-reserved>

**Introduce me to series A-C engineering leaders (Founders, CTOs, VP of Eng):** Many of the later stage startups we’ve talked to have the majority of their engineers shipping with claude, codex or cursor on migrations, backfills and pretty much any code that hits the DB. They will eventually crash their production DB unless they’re rigorously testing. I’d like to prevent those crashes :)

Contact me: [vikram@tryardent.com](mailto:vikram@tryardent.com)

Technology has taken all of our attention, and AI has commoditized intelligence. Understanding how we feel and why has never been harder or more valuable.

We've become obsessed with tracking everything: sleep, recovery, performance. All proxies for how we feel.

Performance is 90% mental. And yet, no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions.

**What we’re building**

Anoria is a bracelet that reads your emotional state in real time. We call this your Flow Score, built from your Energy, Mood, and Focus.

It's powered by SOMI, our state-of-mind inference model, which uses a deep neuroscience framework to correlate 150 audio and biometric signals to surface what you're feeling, why, and what to do about it _(listen to a track by Eminem, call your friend Alex…)_.

With a tight enough feedback loop, emotional intelligence becomes trainable, and your flow state repeatable.

**Who is it for?**

We’re building this for founders and creatives. People who understand that their state of mind is their most important asset.

**Development Status**

Two months in, a handful of users are wearing our first prototypes in the wild. They see their Flow Score in real time, and watch it shift with the people they talk to, the apps they use, the meetings they have, and the music they listen to.

**About us**

I spent five years designing iPhones at Apple, most recently leading the iPhone 17 Pro enclosure. I learned what it means to be obsessive about every detail and still ship 100 million devices a year.

For a decade, I've been obsessed with one question: can human emotion be scientifically understood and quantified?

I built Anoria as a solo founder. Today, an incredible five-person team of ex-Apple and ex-Meta engineers and repeat founders is building it with me. We're going all in on technology that makes self-awareness tangible, and helps us reconnect.

launches.title: Expanse - Unlock wasted GPU capacity
launches.tagline: Unlock wasted GPU capacity.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Expanse unlocks wasted GPU capacity. We’re the intelligence layer for compute infrastructure. Submit jobs with the right resources. Optimise them to run faster. Debug failures in seconds, not days. Works on cloud and on-prem HPC.

Want to know how much more you can get out of your hardware? Schedule a call: <https://book.getexpanse.io>

**Problem**

Running compute on a cluster means guessing memory, time, and GPUs before you submit. Get it wrong and your job fails mid-run. Over-guess and you pay for compute you never use. 30% of cloud spend is lost to over-allocation \[1\]. Microsoft Research found their own deep learning jobs hit 50% GPU utilisation or lower \[2\].

Sizing jobs takes decades of experience. Memory patterns, batching, GPU threading, CPU vectorisation. AI agents don’t have enough information to fix it either. SLURM and Kubernetes don’t expose enough structured data. Even strong platform teams are forced to choose: spend time debugging and optimising every job, or accept the waste. AI infrastructure spending will hit $2.52 trillion in 2026 \[3\]. The waste grows with every new cluster. This problem isn’t going away.

**Solution**

Expanse learns your cluster. We analyse your code and hardware telemetry, then track them over time. Our deep learning models build a picture of what your workloads actually need. Predictions get sharper with every job.

Our models are deployed on your cluster. All analysis runs on your network. Your code and telemetry never leave your infrastructure. We can’t see your data, and you maintain full data sovereignty.

One command installs Expanse on your cluster. You get two tools.

`expanse analyse` - for every job:

* **Suggests the right resource configuration**
* **Predicts failures from historical code and telemetry patterns**
* **Surfaces code-level optimisations that increase efficiency**

`expanse diagnose` - for every failure:

* **Finds the root cause**
* **Returns solution-oriented logs with the exact code and config changes to fix it**

Days of debugging and optimising become seconds. Platform teams get what they need to do this in minutes instead of weeks.

**Founders**

We're four engineers from the University of Edinburgh, all coming from top quant funds and national supercomputing centres. Ismaeel built the first multimodal HPC resource predictor at EPCC (Edinburgh's Parallel Computing Centre), beating every published baseline. Yafet built the first GNN cluster graph network for predicting SLURM queue wait times. Eren built decentralised foundation model training systems at Edinburgh. Niko trained large-scale speech ML models on GPU clusters and architected cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure at one of the largest hedge funds in the world. We left our jobs to fix this ourselves.

**CTA / Ask**

Running compute and not getting enough out of what you’re paying for? Failing jobs, unclear errors, bills too high? We’d love to chat.

Know anyone in AI infrastructure (managing cloud and/or on-premise data centres), quant finance, drug discovery, or AI research labs? An intro would mean a lot :)

**YC Deal**

All YC companies running serious ML training can contact us for a discounted pilot. We’ll find inefficiencies and wastage on your compute setup. Then we deploy Expanse, no changes to your workflows. You get more out of the hardware you’re paying for.

Reach out: [founders@expanse.sh](mailto:founders@expanse.sh) or <https://book.getexpanse.io>

References

\[1\] <https://grafana.com/blog/2023/03/03/how-to-optimize-resource-utilization-with-kubernetes-monitoring-for-grafana-cloud>

\[2\] <https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/an-empirical-study-on-low-gpu-utilization-of-deep-learning-jobs/>

\[3\] <https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-1-15-gartner-says-worldwide-ai-spending-will-total-2-point-5-trillion-dollars-in-2026>

launches.title: Klaimee insures your AI Agents
launches.tagline: Klaimee is the first purpose-build E&O coverage for AI agents.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: [Klaimee](https://klaimee.ai) is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind.**

80% of Fortune 500 companies are already using AI agents. That’s creating a new kind of liability risk no one is really covering yet.\
Enterprises want AI. But they want to know “who pays if something goes wrong”? There’s no clear answer today.\
Meanwhile, AI-related lawsuits are up 137% between 2024 and 2025.

> 👋 Hi, we are Ines and Julien.\
> [Ines](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ines-boutemadja/) was General Manager at SafetyWing (W18), she spent the last 5 years building insurance products from scratch, structured a Tokio Marine MGA, and got the Puerto Rico carrier license, scaling an insurance startup from $5M to $60M. She ran this playbook before, doing it again, AI-native this time.\
> [Julien](https://www.linkedin.com/in/julien-catonnet/) handles the engineering and enterprise compliance side. He has a strategy consulting background, working with corporates and insurance, coupled with a deep software engineering and AI expertise.\
> 🔥 Our team brings the best of both worlds to underwrite the new emerging AI risk.

### **💡 The opportunity:**

Traditional insurance was built for deterministic software; it either works or throws an explicit error. AI agents fail silently and not uniformly. So cyber won't cover it. E&O won't cover it either.

The existing insurance industry lacks the velocity and deep AI knowledge to fill this gap.

We built [Klaimee](https://klaimee.ai) to do exactly that: we provide liability insurance, financial guarantee, critical risk evaluation, certification, and procurement documentation enterprises require, all in under 24 hours.

Watch our launch video below <https://youtu.be/Y7VBNr81b5Y>

### **⚙️ How we do it:**

To insure AI agents, we had to reinvent how traditional underwriting works. Our proprietary, three-block system determines an agent’s risk score and insurance price:

1. **Public Data Scan:** We scan publicly available data related to the agent.
2. **Governance Assessment:** We ask 30 questions concerning the agent’s governance.
3. **Behavioral Testing:** We actually test your agent’s behavior, firing more than 100 probes (prompt injection, jailbreak, decision drift, data leakage, biased outputs) to understand _when_ and _how_ it fails.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100700&key=user_uploads/2955371/49d6f4de-8787-48c4-a6b2-728323148e81)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100700&key=user_uploads/2955371/9ebe5a9c-7ce0-4d29-b3f5-c7017ca8d0d7)

**Score it. Certify it. Underwrite it. Insure it ▷ with a 24h turnaround.**

We bring the trust layers so startups and enterprises can deploy agentic AI with peace of mind.

### **🛡️ What we cover: AI agents in healthcare and biotech, finance & accounting, IT & software development, law & legal tech, customers support and sales agents.**

AI Agents act like humans: they take actions, make decisions, and have a real impact that can cause damages. At[ Klaimee](https://klaimee.ai), we cover the actual behavior of the AI agents. Real failure modes happening in production right now:

* An agent hallucinated a contract clause your customer relied on.
* An agent leaked one patient’'s data to another.
* An agent made a biased call in lending, hiring, or pricing.
* An agent took an unauthorized action with financial damage downstream.

### **⌛️ Why now:**

Major insurers like Berkshire, Chubb, and Travelers are winning state approval to exclude AI liability from standard commercial policies, leaving every agent-deploying company exposed. And it is leaving every agent-deploying company exposed.

The ISO, which sets standards for 70% of the U.S. market, is making AI exclusions the default for Commercial General Liability policies (ISO CG 40 47 / CG 40 48 endorsements). The EU AI Act enforces in August 2026.

Every Fortune 500 procurement team is now asking the AI insurance question, and the answer from incumbents is "we exclude that."

The same thing happened with cyber 20 years ago. It got carved out of existing policies. A whole new line of insurance was created. The same shift is happening with AI right now. And nobody has built the product for it yet.

Ines has done this in insurance before. Julien goes deep on the AI side. Together we know how to actually price the risk.

We understand what enterprise buyers need to see, and why a startup can’t sit around for 6 months waiting on a traditional carrier.

If you’re shipping AI agents into enterprise, you should already be thinking about coverage.

### We’re underwriting our first cohort now → [**klaimee.ai**](http://klaimee.ai)

**TLDR:** Andco's AI agents run the entire pre-litigation workup for personal injury firms across every channel they use: fax, email, mail, web, SMS, and voice - so they can scale their firm without overhead.

**The first 24 hours of a case, with Andco**

The moment a PI firm signs a new client, a race starts. Police reports need to be pulled, insurers need to be called, medical providers need to be faxed (yes, still faxed). Our agents go off across all channels in parallel: requesting the police report, opening claims with carriers like Geico and Progressive, identifying UM/UIM coverage, engaging adjusters, requesting records and bills from every treating provider, and running follow-up cadences until everything lands. Roughly 8 hours of legal staff work, done before anyone at the firm sits down at their desk.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1126674/72f429e1-75ec-45b9-8481-5fac0d0dce5a)

**The Problem**

Personal injury is a $50B+ industry, and firms live or die on pre-litigation workup speed. The problem: every case requires chasing dozens of documents from police departments, insurance carriers, and medical providers — most of whom still run on fax, mail, and phone. Firms have two options today

1. Hire armies of legal staff + paralegals (expensive, high turnover, caps your caseload)
2. Outsource to point-solution retrieval vendors (slow, opaque, expensive per-request)

Legal tech built for this has historically been document and case management systems — great for storing things, terrible at actually doing the work. Meanwhile AI tooling in PI has mostly focused on downstream workflows like medical chronologies and demand drafting, which still depend on someone else getting the case context in first.

**The Solution**

Andco runs the pre-lit workup end-to-end. We're the system that actually does the work of getting the context. Our agents operate across fax, email, mail, web, SMS, and voice - the same channels your legal staff uses, plus a few they can't scale on. We're live with PI firms across the US and are exploring pilots with the world's largest injury law firms.

Early results:

• 8 hours saved in the first 24 hours of a case

• 24+ hours saved between intake and demand

We're a team of repeat founders, ex-lawyers, and builders.

launches.title: HYBRD - agentic coaching for athletes
launches.tagline: get faster and stronger
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re the team behind HYBRD - Ruiters, Shoe, Ben, Michael and Mats. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/b570d491-7243-4a3c-8660-ca425a646339)

We’re excited to share that today **HYBRD is becoming a coach in your pocket.** It’s like having a $500/month private coach on call 24/7. We provide a world-class training plan, then adapt it based on your life, progress, and recovery to keep you on track. 

\
[LINK TO DEMO VIDEO](https://youtube.com/shorts/PgPKkJqbYs0)

ASK: [TRY IT NOW ON THE APP STORE](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

\
**Introducing HYBRD Brain**

HYBRD Brain is our AI-powered coach built on top of HYBRD's structured training plans. Tell Brain about your schedule, sport mix, travel, or injuries — and it restructures your entire plan accordingly.

## **⭐ Why HYBRD is different**

These aren't ChatGPT-slop training plans.

We've partnered with Alex Viada (creator of the term "hybrid athlete") and his Complete Human Performance team to use their world-class programming as HYBRD's foundation. Our agent adapts those plans to you while preserving best-in-class athletic methodology.

(Alex also bought an iPhone just to use HYBRD)

**HYBRD Brain can coach you to achieve anything**

* Training for a marathon but also playing soccer twice a week? HYBRD Brain adjusts your running volume.
* Tweaked your Achilles and need to back off temporarily? HYBRD Brain rebuilds your training block.
* Traveling for work and missed three sessions? HYBRD Brain recalculates what comes next so you don’t lose momentum.

Instead of forcing you to follow a plan that breaks on contact with reality, HYBRD Brain builds a plan that adapts to you. 

**HYBRD actually does things**

Chatting with your health data is cool, but not useful. Most apps just regurgitate your charts back to you (you know how to read a graph) and recommend the CDC's 75 minutes of vigorous activity per week.

These tools feel disappointing because they don't know your actual goals and constraints, like upcoming races, equipment and your schedule, so they can't do anything meaningful with the data they collect.

HYBRD understands your goals and proactively proposes adjustments that fit your plan. Unplanned workouts, missed sessions, fatigue, cross-training, new PRs… HYBRD recognizes these moments and reorganizes your schedule around them.

**HYBRD uses ALL of your workout data**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet. 

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**HYBRD is adaptive to your history, current level and progress**

HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources, pulling in your full workout history and deduplicating it. From that data, we give you a holistic view of your strength and cardio fitness, normalized for age, gender, and weight, as a single score you can track over time.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting: we interpret it all to model your physiology and personalize your plan.

Say you want to train more like Alex Viada. You probably aren't deadlifting 700lbs and logging 15+ hours a week (yet?). We scale the fundamentals of his programming down to exactly where you are now.

**FitBench**

Ok, it wouldn't be an AI launch without benchmarking.

We built **FitBench**, a benchmark that evaluates an AI coach across four dimensions: Scientific accuracy, athlete safety, recommendation actionability and conciseness across 25 common coaching scenarios. We used Opus 4.6 as an LLM-as-a-judge to score HYBRD Brain against current ChatGPT and its predecessors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/c6e545d7-114b-4cc5-9e1f-806f7197e7d2)

But how does that compare with human coaches?

We had HYBRD sit for the **Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS)** exam, which is the gold standard in coaching. You need 70% to pass (half of all human test-takers don't make it). HYBRD scored 77%.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/4cfa2415-0d8f-4106-850b-f15fcf307d54)

\
**Our Story**

Ben, Mats, and Shoe all met while working on getting WHOOP to PMF. At the time, outside of work, Mats was training on the US national rowing team and Ben + Shoe were making their first forays into Ironman training.

We realized that fitness hardware was getting really good, but also was being commoditized. (Just take a look at Coros brutally undercutting Garmin prices)

For all the data being collected, existing products weren’t providing real coaching to multi-disciplinary “hybrid” athletes like us, partly because none were built to handle strength + cardio data, and partly because models weren’t good enough. 

Most athletes are still following static PDF plans they found online, or "adaptive" apps that fall apart the moment cross-training enters the picture.

We teamed up with our co-founder and CTO Ruiters (a senior AWS engineer at the time) and Michael (our founding engineer) to solve that with HYBRD. 

If that problem resonates with you, [try a 7 day free trial of HYBRD!](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

**TL;DR** - Wafer Pass is a single subscription that gives you the fastest optimized open-source LLMs for any agentic coding harness. Plans start at $10/week. Every plan includes every model we host. Sign up at [wafer.ai/pass](https://www.wafer.ai/#pricing).

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1616952/7ea613a4-5300-4377-9fbe-32791825a31e)

## Hi YC! We're Emilio and Steven, founders of Wafer (S25)

Today we're launching **Wafer Pass**, a flat-rate API subscription to the fastest optimized open-source LLMs. One key, every model, drops into Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cline, Kilo Code, Roo Code, OpenHands, or Conductor.

## **The problem**

If you use AI coding agents, you've felt the pain. Usage caps that hit at the worst moment. Per-token bills that swing between $5 and $50 a session. Juggling API keys across providers. Watching frontier closed models throttle you on Friday afternoons.

Open-source models (Qwen3.5-397B, GLM5.1, DeepSeek V4 Pro) have closed most of the gap on coding tasks. The problem is getting them served at the speed you actually want for an agent loop. Most providers run them on stock SGLang or vLLM, which leaves 50–80% of GPU performance on the table.

## **What we built**

Wafer's core product is an AI performance engineer. You point it at an LLM and it optimizes it.

We have been pointing Wafer at the leading open-source LLMs and let it rewrite the entire serving stack: kernels, batching, scheduling, memory layout. The results are really impressive so far: 

* Qwen3.5-397B-Turbo is 2.8x faster than base SGLang
* GLM5.1-Turbo is 2x faster than vLLM baseline
* DeepSeek-V4-Pro is 2x faster than vLLM baseline

The Qwen example: 

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1616952/5a00eeba-4de9-4052-a0ab-5643908058cd)

Same weights as anywhere else. Just faster, because Wafer rewrote the kernels. We put the result behind a single OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API.

## **Wafer Pass**

One subscription. One API key. Every model we host.

* **$10/week (Starter):** 1,000 requests every 5 hours. All models.
* **$25/week (Privacy):** 2,000 requests every 5 hours. All models. Zero Data Retention.

Every plan includes every model, and every future Turbo model we ship. No price increase as the catalog grows. For context: that's 10x requests than Claude Code Max, at 1/2 the price. 

## **Try it**

**Sign up: [wafer.ai/pass](https://wafer.ai/pass)**

If you use Claude Code, OpenClaw, or any other agent harness, we'd love your feedback. Drop your Wafer API key in and tell us what breaks.

If you're building an agent or coding tool and want a default model layer, let's talk.

Email: [**emilio@wafer.ai**](mailto:emilio@wafer.ai) · Book a 15-min call: **cal.com/wafer/quick-chat**

**HEVN: Brex for non-US companies**

\*\*Tl;Dr;\*\*\
Banking for non-US internet companies is hard. HEVN provides an alternative: open virtual bank accounts in 1 day, get USD cards with 0% FX, and send/receive ACH, SEPA, wires, and USDC.

**The problem**

For non-US companies, USD banking takes months, requires travel, and often breaks after the first transactions — making it hard to get paid via Stripe, Apple, or run global payroll.

In practice:

* 2-20 weeks to open an account in UAE or Hong Kong
* Founders have to fly in-person just to pass KYC
* $20K+ per year in legal and banking fees
* Accounts get frozen after first SWIFT transfer
* Visa charge 2-3% FX fee on USD payments

**At the same time, Brex, Ramp, and Mercury only support US companies with an EIN.**

**What HEVN does**

HEVN is a B2B financial platform that lets global internet companies operate in USD — without needing a US entity.

* Run your business in USD with corporate cards and global payments with 0% FX fees
* Get named local accounts in EU, US, HK and UAE banks in 1 day
* Send and receive ACH / SEPA / USDC / wires worldwide
* (soon) Store USD in FDIC-insured US accounts, even without an EIN

**Video Launch**\
<https://youtu.be/RBr87D4AZKk>

**Backstory**

We previously built HOT Labs, a Web3 infrastructure company behind a 15M-user wallet.\
\
While operating globally, we kept running into the same problem: banking didn’t work.

* One of us spent 6 months opening a UAE account — only to face an AML check right after the first transaction
* Another had to fly twice just to open an account

We worked with dozens companies, and most of them ended up using stablecoins because traditional banking failed. Now 12 of them - our customers.

We built HEVN to help global internet companies focus on running and scaling their business, with the same access to US financial services as US companies.

Today, we’re fully ready to serve cumpanies in the UAE and are looking to onboard pilot customers in Hong Kong and Singapore.

* **Did you work at Stripe or Apple Store before?** Any introductions to the team that could help us set up Stripe/Apple payouts to virtual bank accounts would be very helpful.
* **Are you a YC company based internationally?** you can use HEVN for global baking or stablecoins **completely free**

launches.title: Warmly - Always-On AI Sales Agent for Your Website
launches.tagline: AI that gives demos, qualifies leads, and books meetings on your website 24/7
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋 We're Max, Carina and Alan, founders of Warmly.ai.

**TL;DR**: We just launched **AI Autopilot**: an always-on agent that lives on every page of your website, identifies visitors at the person level before any form fill, gives demos, qualifies prospects, books meetings, and retargets the rest. Customers running it are converting 30% more inbound traffic. Setup is a script tag and 30 minutes.

Launch announcement [here](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/) (would greatly appreciate a comment!).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EHybZmEzyTs>

**The Problem**

Most B2B SaaS companies are bleeding pipeline through their front door.

Your website is your highest-leverage asset. Every visitor you've paid for lands there. They often have the problem you solve but you just might not be fast enough to get to them in time before they leave or go to a competitor.

Buyers now expect to talk to someone immediately. They don’t want to wait a day to schedule a call with an SDR to get a basic question answered.

But every "AI chatbot" we've seen since 2023 has the same architecture under the hood: a stateless GPT wrapper that rebuilds context from scratch on every message, hallucinates, and hands off "qualified" leads with no traceability.

AEs aren’t fans and buyers see through them in two messages.

**What we built**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkvDdJCsqd8>

AI Autopilot is one agent on every page of your site. It pulls from your website, help center, internal docs, sales calls, sales methodologies, and CRM.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/409563/3ec0d6d3-bdec-4a67-9c20-5937dd63216d)

It picks its own qualification path. It generates slide decks on the fly mid-conversation, triggers the right videos by intent, and offers an optional video avatar so visitors talk to a person instead of a widget.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/409563/368692f0-3842-48b8-8297-2cdd41ab78d7)

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/409563/e3d90e0a-3c84-418b-b28e-445d7ee67dd4)

When the visitor doesn't book? AI Autopilot doesn't give up. It Slacks your team, sends a personalized follow-up email, and triggers LinkedIn retargeting for your top prospects.

It self-improves.

It analyzes every conversation against the goals you set, tunes itself, and is version controlled. You can watch it get better over time.

In our beta accounts, automated inbound meetings increased 30%.

**Why now**

We started out compiling signals for B2B sales/marketing teams, like person-level website visitor data.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/409563/49b7ce12-478d-4b6f-a812-7a0810f6272a)

In the past year we took a different bet: build a context graph for B2B GTM first, then put agents on top of it.

The context graph is a unified, real-time data layer that connects every signal, action, note, and outcome for every account. When AI Autopilot engages a visitor, it knows they saw your LinkedIn ad last week, your SDR sent a follow-up email yesterday, and they downloaded a case study an hour ago. It doesn't have to "look this up.” The context is already pre-computed in primitive stores it can query in milliseconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/409563/784e00dd-623d-42b2-94e4-fc67416b54a0)

A blog post we wrote that covers how we think about the GTM space: [GTM Brain: Next Platform Owns Decisions, Not Data](https://www.warmly.ai/blog/gtm-brain).

**Asks for the YC community**

1\. **Drop us a comment on our [launch post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/)**. We’d love for more of our community to know us for building GTM agents and not just supply GTM data :).

2\. **Try us out.** Book a demo with us if this is something you’re interested in! <https://www.warmly.ai/p/book-a-demo>

Warmly,

Max, Carina & Alan

launches.tagline: AI broker connecting American brands with the world's best factories.

# **Hey 👋** We're Edward and Jennifer, founders of **Saudara AI**.

**TL;DR:** We're an AI broker connecting American brands with the world’s best international factories. Saudara is built by a third-generation manufacturer and an Amazon supply chain veteran, two people who've spent their careers on both sides of this problem. 

We don’t just sell software, we sell outcomes and services. Real humans do the work, supercharged by AI, at 10x the speed and a fraction of the cost of traditional sourcing agents.

International sourcing is hard. We make it easy.

<https://youtu.be/tna8cqJsfok>

**❌ The Problem**

Sourcing overseas should be straightforward. It never is. Five traps catch almost every foreign buyer, and most never see it coming.

* **Trust** — Suppliers overpromise, cut corners on mass production, and go quiet after the deposit clears.
* **Price** — Unbeatable quotes hide lower grade materials, hidden fees, and cost hikes once you're locked in.
* **Timing** — Missed deadlines kill holiday season sales, trigger chargebacks, and derail launches.
* **Payment terms** — New buyers pay 100% upfront. Established buyers get net-60. The playing field has never been level.
* **Scalability** — A supplier that works at 500 units may fall apart at 50,000.

**✅ Our Solution**

Saudara means "family" in Indonesian. Jennifer's family has spent 50+ years building relationships across Asian manufacturing. We don't blindly search for suppliers. We have their personal numbers.

We're a broker, not a marketplace. You tell us what you need, we deliver it. Our relationships get us into factories that don't take cold inquiries. Our AI handles the rest, vetting, benchmarking, negotiation support, QC tracking, and logistics, end-to-end.

* **Trust, protected** — Our AI flags supplier inconsistencies and tells you when something looks too good to be true.
* **Price transparency** — Every quote benchmarked against real market data. You always know what's fair.
* **Specs, timelines, and QC** — Spec sheets locked before approval, milestones tracked proactively, quality checked from raw materials to shipment.
* **Better payment terms** — We negotiate 30/70 and net-60 on your behalf. The terms established buyers take for granted, available from day one.
* **Suppliers that can scale** — Matched to your volume today and where you're going tomorrow.

**🌿 Starting With Indonesia?**

We're starting with Indonesia because it's where we're from, and because most of it is still inaccessible to Western buyers without the right relationships. We have them.

Palm oil, vanilla, nickel, rattan, patchouli, charcoal briquettes, handcrafted furniture from Jepara, and one of Southeast Asia's strongest apparel manufacturing bases. Resource-rich, largely untapped, and relationship-gated.

**👫 The Team**

**Edward** **Haryono** — Grew up around Indonesian logistics. Amazon supply chain background. President of IABA-PNW (Non profit promoting Indonesia and Pacific Northwest Economic Relations)

**Jennifer Prasetyo** — Third-generation Indonesian manufacturer. Nationally trusted sourcing expert behind [@jenandtech](https://www.instagram.com/jenandtech/) (95K+ followers across all socials).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100462&key=user_uploads/2623220/a382ed9a-3817-412d-83cc-92cdf7b763a2)

**Source Smarter**

Stop gambling on suppliers. If you or someone you know is sourcing products internationally, send them our way. Start with [Saudara.](https://saudara.ai)

Or, book a call [here](https://calendly.com/saudara/start-sourcing)

Companies today are pushing for AI adoption, but regulated industries often can’t due to privacy and security constraints. Soren enables them to run private, custom AI systems entirely within their own environment.

Companies in regulated industries (e.g. finance, healthcare, and legal services) are under pressure to adopt AI, but strict data protection and compliance requirements _make it difficult_.

Larger enterprises work around this by building internal engineering teams or working directly with the big AI labs.

**Smaller institutions don’t have that option**, leaving them unable to adopt AI or limiting them to only a few use cases. In some cases, they push for adoption while downplaying security and privacy controls.

launches.title: Saffron: Find Your Next 10x Engineer
launches.tagline: Companies use Saffron to evaluate how well software engineers use AI to code.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Saffron gives candidates a real codebase and ability to use any AI tooling they'd use on the job. We capture every prompt, diff, and decision in a sandboxed environment that gets scored automatically. Teams can now get structured metrics on how candidates actually build, not just whether the final output compiles.

Book an onboarding call here: [**https://trysaffron.ai**](https://trysaffron.ai)

**Our Launch Video**

<https://youtu.be/pJHXqTKKMRQ>

---

**The Problem**

AI coding tools have finally gotten good enough to actually change how engineers work. But the way companies evaluate SWEs hasn't changed at all.

Now, interviews are testing the wrong thing and candidates are passing every round of your hiring process, before showing up on the job unable to build a single feature without AI doing the thinking for them.

On the flip side, companies are missing out on engineers who actually know how to use AI to be ten times more efficient.

We know because we've been on both sides. As candidates, we realized how how much potential there was to become 10x with AI. As founders, we’ve heard the same story from dozens of teams: "They crushed the interview. Two weeks in, they couldn't ship anything independently."

---

**Our Approach**

We’ve built an assessment that embraces AI and measures how efficient an engineer is. Candidates get a real codebase, AI tools they’d actually use on the job, and a task that simulates engineering work. We capture the full process and evaluate it automatically.

---

**⚙️ How It Works**

**Step 1: Create an assessment in under 5 minutes.** Point us at your GitHub repo or choose a question from our bank, configure AI agents, and invite candidates.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=100291&key=user_uploads%2F2767627%2F8e7827fe-4250-4411-b495-f0b5d2dbbd18&variant=large)

**Step 2: Candidates build in a fully managed environment.** They get an online IDE that they can customize, a timer, and a real task. No setup required on their end. After coding, they answer debrief questions about their own implementation — and we verify their answers.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=100291&key=user_uploads%2F2767627%2F9e27fefd-a405-4ae1-859c-5b83c72af8e0&variant=large)

**Step 3: Review results without reading a single line of code.** AI review agents score the submission across dimensions you configure with specific evidence from the codebase. We show you detailed metrics like prompts, AI reliance percentage, or tool calling, and give a deterministic score on how well the candidate did.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=100291&key=user_uploads%2F2767627%2F3645c5c3-534f-4a40-a8d9-d662bd13a0e9&variant=large)

---

**Why Us**

We’re Robert, Jerry, and Kazuma. We met in high school, started building together, and have been close friends ever since. Robert studied at MIT and was at Jane Street. Jerry studied at Stanford and was also at Jane Street. Kazuma studied at Harvey Mudd and was published in NeurIPS and ICML.

All three of us were CS students recruiting for SWE jobs the entirety of our first semester of college. And after noticing how much our coding workflow had changed with the introduction of better and better models, we knew that assessments had to catch up.

---

**Our Ask**

* **Hiring SWEs?** We'll set up your first assessment for free, configure it to your codebase, and work with you 1:1 to build out whatever you need. We're early and hungry. Book a call: [**https://trysaffron.ai**](https://trysaffron.ai)
* **Know an engineering lead, head of talent, or recruiter** who's frustrated with their current process? We'd love an intro.

Can't wait to hear your feedback!

\-Robert, Jerry, and Kazuma

launches.title: Salesgraph - your marketers, analysts, & strategists, working 24/7 on every deal.
launches.tagline: Automate context gathering, collateral, and strategy for enterprise sales teams
launches.body:
Hey we’re [Ruhan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ruhanponnada/) and [Ricardo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ricardonunez-01/) - engineer turned seller, and seller turned engineer.

**Offer:** Get a free [GTM Audit ](https://www.salesgraph.com/gtm-audit)on your company or prospects + if you intro us to a closer, for a meeting booked, get free Lulu merch!\
\
**TL;DR** Salesgraph automates deal context and collateral for enterprise sales teams, so every rep walks into every call prepared and leaves every call with clear next steps. We're a headless UI, starting with a Slack-native experience that integrates with your CRM, calendar, call recordings, docs, blogs, case studies, and research.

<https://youtu.be/fO6c2wIPwIw>
\
**The Problem:**
Sales reps have too much on their plate: back-to-back meetings, Slack messages from prospects, follow-up emails, and coordination with SEs. The best reps balance this. The rest forget to follow up, come to calls unprepared, and lose deals at pricing because they can't value sell.\
\
This gets harder when you're selling a technical product as a non-technical rep. You can't articulate value if you don't fully understand what you're selling, so reps default to features, line items, and discounts.\
\
**The Result:** enterprise deals die in procurement. \
\
When reps walk in without a clear business case, procurement has all the leverage. Deals stall on price, ACV gets discounted away, or the deal dies entirely.

We lived this at Mintlify. Reps looked great on paper, but folded under pressure. The truth is, sales is as much nurturing as it is selling. The best reps act like consultants, not order takers.\
\
**Our Solution:** At an internal Mintlify hackathon, our Head of Sales paired with Ricardo to build an internal tool: a value case generator trained on call recordings, past deals, case studies, ROI calculators, and the MEDDIC framework. The output was a 3-page business case our champions used to sell Mintlify internally — driving higher ACVs and helping us close millions from enterprise logos.

Why can’t we evangelize every GTM team to close deals at higher ACV through encouraging value selling? \
\
We took those learnings to build Salesgraph.

In Slack, reps get proactive context 5 minutes before every call — triggers from background agents, key notes from previous calls, and what to cover next. After every call, they get a DM with strengths, gaps to address, and next steps.

We integrate with major call recorders and ship our own ambient recorder (a sales-focused alternative to Granola), **free for founders and teams under 3**.\
\
**Why this matters for everyone, not just reps:**

* **Sales managers** query deal state directly in Slack, no more reading low-quality opp notes or meaningless health scores
* **SEs and FDEs** stop watching call recordings at 2x speed; they just ask in Slack
* **Customer success** sees what was actually promised vs delivered

\
