Hi everyone! We’re [Kevin](https://x.com/kevinlu1248) and [William](https://www.linkedin.com/in/william-zeng/), and we’re building a better AI autocomplete for JetBrains.

**TLDR;** [Sweep](https://sweep.dev/) is a free autocomplete plugin for IntelliJ / PyCharm that is smarter than Cursor Tab.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95289&key=user_uploads/1214046/931362f2-24b9-4d5b-aa4b-778cd98aacbc)

# The Problem

Developers writing production-grade code need tools like autocomplete that keep them in the loop rather than agents that take them out of it.\
\
JetBrains users don’t have an AI autocomplete that works well. The leading plugins are not products that users love:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95289&key=user_uploads/1214046/f78574aa-2dfe-4d58-82a5-a284b8ca1147)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95289&key=user_uploads/1214046/72d4698c-42be-404b-9d1b-9b6d9869d201)

# Our Solution: Sweep 🧹

We’re building tools for professional developers using JetBrains, starting with super fast autocomplete that’s smarter than Cursor Tab.\
\
We’ve fine-tuned our own LLM with a custom inference stack that suggests completions with sub-100ms latency. Unlike Cursor, we use the JetBrains code index to let our autocomplete model navigate your code like a real developer.

We’ve heard great feedback so far:

_“AI is finally useful inside JetBrains — thanks to sweep. **A million times better than JetBrains’ own tools.**” -_ Christiaan Bilthof, CTO @ Leat

_“Compared to every other tool and IDE I've used, **it's incredibly fast** - so much so that the next tab predictions and autocomplete feel instantaneous.” -_ Ashkan Aghdai, Staff Engineer @ Amplitude\
\
_“I used to have to choose between using PyCharm and good autocomplete - but with Sweep, I get both. **It’s a massive productivity boost.**”_ **-** Josiah Parappally, Staff Engineer @ Ramp

## Why we built Sweep

We originally started Sweep in 2023 to build an AI junior developer, which hit 7.6k stars on GitHub.

We soon realized that this was many years out. Instead, we decided to build a coding assistant that developers could use today. Kevin and I have been JetBrains users since we were in college, and we were surprised something like this didn’t exist yet.

We built Sweep for ourselves, and use Sweep Tab hundreds of times a day to write production-grade code instead of vibe coding. It’s boosted our productivity by 2x and we hope you like it too. \

launches.title: Iris: The Digital Extension of Yourself
launches.tagline: Designed to keep you ahead.
launches.body:
Hi everyone,

We’re Samika & Siddhant - cousins and co-founders of [Iris](https://www.textiris.com\)). Our aim is to create a true digital extension of your mind that can take off 20-30% of your daily workload. 

https://youtu.be/bBxS2SGIIx0

❌ **The Problem**:\
The problem isn’t a lack of tools - it’s that they all expect you to think like them. Between five calendars, three inboxes, and constant context switching, simple things like moving a meeting or replying to an email still take minutes of mental load. Apps like Motion or Reclaim help you plan, but they don’t understand you. They still need perfect inputs, perfect routines, perfect focus.

We didn’t need another productivity system to maintain - we needed something that worked with how we already do things.\
\
✅ **The Solution**\
Iris is a digital extension of yourself that learns how _you_ work. She observes how you reply, decide, and prioritize - the small behavioral patterns that make up your day - and uses them to prepare the next set of actions automatically. **The core insight is simple: if you model real behavior, you can replicate judgment.** With personal agents and a knowledge graph, Iris reduces the mental load of constant context switching by pre-filling the actions you would take, the way you would take them. You simply swipe to hand it off to your proxy.

We started with email and calendars. In four weeks, over 1,200 people have downloaded Iris, 168 use it daily, and they’ve taken more than 36,000 actions - growing 48% week over week. **This is the first real step toward a future where everyone has a personal digital extension running their day with near-perfect accuracy.**\
\
**The Team**\
We’re cousins who’ve been building together since we were kids.

Samika previously worked on adaptive AI systems at CMU for a year, and studied how humans build trust in AI.

Siddhant has been coding since he was 11, he built and launched 12 consumer apps with 2500+ active users. He studied Computer Science from UCSD.

Earlier in the batch, we met Adam Cheyer (founder of Siri), who became a mentor and advisor. That conversation reshaped how we think about assistants - not as UX problems, but as deep engineering problems.

launches.title: Agentic Fabriq: Okta for Agents
launches.tagline: Power your AI with governed data
launches.body:
Hey everyone! This is [Paulina](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulina-xu-5bba0821b/) & [Matthew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-xu-b32a36271/) from Agentic Fabriq.

**TL;DR:** Agentic Fabriq is Okta for agents. Fabriq ensures that employees can’t access data or do actions with agents that they themselves would not have permissions to do.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/d57b9148-8a8a-44a0-8c53-1292f611641b)

Our launch video:[ https://youtu.be/V4dTw58ZeTQ?si=ykoz3x06_fTgEXeK](https://youtu.be/V4dTw58ZeTQ?si=ykoz3x06_fTgEXeK)

The field of agentic AI is brand new, and everyone is rushing to build and ship their own agents. But there’s a critical gap appearing: **how do you guarantee an agent can’t do more than the employee using it?**

**THE PROBLEM**

AI is rewriting how work gets done, but most companies still can’t let every employee harness it with **their own, permissioned data**. The market is full of tools and agents, but **the core organizational layer is missing**. There’s no unified place to enforce per-user + least-privilege access, separate tenants, or audit what an agent did, with which user, and why, across all of your internal agents and tools.

Today, there’s only scattered solutions to this with identity and permission systems that were built for humans, not for agents acting as humans. Agentic Fabriq solves this issue **for the first time** by giving IT and admins a way to ensure their agents are always constrained to the **exact permissions of the employee asking** - no more, no less.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Agentic Fabriq is the secure fabric that simplifies data permissioning for all your agents, tools, and employees. We handle the auth & integration so IT & admin can manage employee permissions, agent permissions per employee, and tool connections. We’ve solved the security and identity hurdles so you can connect to a tool in minutes and personalize **what your agents can do and access per user**.

On Fabriq,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/07608446-8a9e-4906-88ff-57c9bd5cb1d4)

register a tool connection,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/8e2c2fb2-38b9-4253-b87a-5894da56de89)

register your own AI/agents,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/f703ec51-0cd0-47e3-99ca-8d330c6fe157)

and manage your entire organization

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/6b9fad2b-5606-4ed6-8e3f-af21f966357b)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/4bbadb2e-6cb7-4858-9343-0b63b8938458)

**we made it as simple as that.**

Agentic Fabriq provides users with:

* **per-user connections**: connect your own account to approved tools - no shared creds
* **org-wide controls**: define what internal agents/apps can access & which employees can use them
* **least-privilege by default**: access is scoped & revocable, with centralized policy
* **full visibility**: every action is logged for audit & compliance
* **prebuilt connectors**: add tools fast without rebuilding auth & permissions each time

This allows teams to make the most use of AI with exactly the data they’re allowed to use - **safely, auditable & at scale.**

**OUR ASK**

If you or anyone you know would like to be early adopters of Fabriq, book a call with us or send us an email!

Paulina and Matthew met @ MIT admit weekend and have been friends since. They dropped out before their second year to work on Agentic Fabriq

Hi everyone! We’re [Harshit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harshitgarg03/) and [Kiran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kiranmohanb/), and we’re building Lexi - AI Associates for law firms & legal teams

### **TL;DR**

Law firms & legal departments spend countless hours drafting, reviewing, organizing, and managing documents.

Unlike other LegalTech tools, Lexi integrates directly into your workflow, acting as an AI associate that learns your team’s standards, tone, and processes to handle your workflows end to end.

**Lexi saves lawyers 10+ hours of manual work every single week.**

[Lexi Launch Video](https://youtu.be/3LSrawsmCfI)

### 🔴 **The Problem**

Lawyers are drowning in low-leverage work.

70% of a lawyer's day is spent on tasks that don't require legal expertise: summarizing documents, drafting routine correspondence, building chronologies, organizing files.

Existing tools don't solve this—they're point solutions that force lawyers to juggle between multiple platforms and subscriptions, slowing them down instead of speeding them up.

The result? Clients wait for updates, strategy gets postponed, and burnout rises. Even top-tier firms struggle to scale without adding headcount.

---

### 🟢 **The Solution**

Lexi doesn't just "help" with legal work—it does the work. From intake to delivery, Lexi acts as a trained associate that learns your firm's style, standards, and processes.

**What used to take 8 hours now takes 20 minutes.**

**Document Intelligence**\
Transform scattered emails, PDFs, and transcripts into organized, searchable case files. Analyze thousands of documents and extract key information with reliable accuracy.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2650346/de522fac-c1ec-4375-a762-74e096a803f6)

**Drafting**\
Generate polished first drafts of pleadings, contracts, and letters in your firm's voice. Lexi learns your writing style and standards to produce documents that need minimal editing.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2650346/f2be1518-b09f-4069-8f0f-7d2f4b693fdc)

**Contract Review**\
Review agreements against your firm's playbooks and flag risky clauses automatically. Lexi learns from your past reviews to improve recommendations and match your standards over time.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2650346/c5c1a104-ed80-4e30-8a1d-1111270646a7)

**Chronology Builder**\
Build comprehensive timelines from thousands of documents. Extract dates, facts, conflicts, and citations instantly—perfect for depositions or trial prep.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2650346/6b475d7c-a3f7-45c6-90d3-35fe6c15124f)

The best part: Lexi **Integrates seamlessly** with the tools you use daily: Microsoft Word, Outlook, Google Docs, iManage, and more. No new systems to learn. No workflow disruption.

**The impact?** Firms using Lexi take on **25% more cases without new hires**—reclaiming 10+ hours per lawyer per week.

---

### 🔵 **The Team**

We've lived this problem from both sides—legal practice and AI engineering.

**Harshit Garg** (CEO) — Practiced law at top firms where he watched talented lawyers lose hours to repetitive work. Built Lexi to give that time back.

**Kiran Mohan** (CTO) — Former Engineering Manager at Ethlas and Shopee. Built AI systems and infrastructure at scale for millions of users. Now building the AI associate every law firm needs..

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2650346/d9190728-ed4d-4e12-acd0-a4cedbd871fe)

Want to see Lexi in action? Book a demo here: [getlexi.io](http://getlexi.io) or reach us at [founders@getlexi.io](mailto:founders@getlexi.io)

launches.title: Nessie: Perplexity for Your Mind
launches.tagline: Turn your AI chats into searchable memory
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95270&key=user_uploads/854295/e88fb9f4-8055-4721-94d1-6959e0d83509)

Hey everyone! We're [Anna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anna-zhang-y/) and [Tiger](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tiger-wang-6a9b06189/) – co-founders of [Nessie](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nessie).

**TLDR**: Nessie turns your scattered AI conversations into a personal knowledge base where you can search, ask questions, and surface new insights.

Many of us now think through AI conversations. Our most creative moments and deepest explorations happen in conversations with AI. Nessie is Perplexity for your mind, giving every AI conversation a permanent memory.

# **The Problem**

Your best ideas are scattered.

Brilliant insights are buried in endless AI chat histories, impossible to find or build upon. Trying to connect an idea from last Tuesday’s chat with a note from today is a nightmare of copying, pasting, and losing context.

Your best ideas deserve to compound.

# **The Solution: A Home for Your Ideas**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FPSfW_0jFr4

Nessie gives your ideas a home—a single, fluid space where your notes and AI conversations live together. It’s a thinking partner that effortlessly captures your insights, building a single, perfect memory of your ideas.

This lets you:

1. **Build your personal knowledge base, effortlessly**.

   Import your entire ChatGPT history, or capture individual conversations that you don’t want to lose. Nessie automatically distills your conversations into structured notes, organized around topics you care about. Your existing ideas become a structured, searchable knowledge base without you lifting a finger.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95270&key=user_uploads/2910312/ac6fef3a-848f-45c9-8b46-667661498cfd)

2. **Instantly find any idea**.

   Search across your entire knowledge base and unearth your most brilliant ideas in seconds. Never lose a thought to a messy chat history again.
3. **Compound your best thinking**.

   Your knowledge base becomes a thinking partner. You can chat with a specific concept, a folder of notes, or your entire knowledge base to connect ideas and create new insights.
4. **Own your mind**.

   We believe agency over your own thinking is critical, especially in the age of AI. Nessie gives you transparent control over your memory. Your knowledge is built from visible, editable notes that you can shape and delete at will. Everything is stored locally and privately on your device—no one can see it but you.

# **Who This Is For**

Nessie is built for AI-native thinkers: the researchers, founders, VCs, and writers who are already using AI as a partner to develop and challenge their ideas. If you live in ChatGPT and feel its limitations every day, we built Nessie for you.

# **Our Vision**

We are building your personal context layer for the AI age. Our vision is a future where your thinking compounds effortlessly, where no idea is ever lost, and your own knowledge becomes your most powerful tool.

# **About Us**

We built Nessie for ourselves.

We met at Yale and bonded over our shared obsession with using AI to push the limits of our own thinking. We quickly hit a wall. Anna had several Gemini chats that crossed the 1M token context window—a massive limit for any major model today. The brilliant insights from those conversations are now effectively lost.

We felt constrained by tools that weren't built for the way we think, so we built the solution we needed.

We use Nessie every single day.

# **Our Ask**

1. **Try Nessie and build your AI second brain.** We are obsessed with feedback from fellow AI power users and would be honored to hear your honest thoughts.
2. **Follow our journey.** We'll be sharing updates, behind-the-scenes, and our learnings as we build in public.
   * [**X/Twitter**](https://x.com/NessieLabs)
   * [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nessie-labs)
   * [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/6DkXCpVu6K)
3. **Share with a friend.** If you know another founder, researcher, or writer who lives in their AI chats and is constantly losing great ideas, we'd love for you to share Nessie with them.

**Download the Nessie Mac app at[ https://nessielabs.com/](https://nessielabs.com/)**

**Contact us at [founders@nessielabs.com](https://mailto:founders@nessielabs.com)**

launches.tagline: Our AI agents conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights into fully auditable reports – replacing the $500K+ due diligence work from McKinsey, BCG, and Bain.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We're Frederik, Soren, and Harshil – co-founders of DiligenceSquared.

**TL;DR**

[DiligenceSquared ](https://diligencesquared.com/)automates **market due diligence for private equity funds**. Our AI agents conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights into fully auditable reports – replacing the $500K+ due diligence work from McKinsey, BCG, and Bain.

We have deep expertise from senior industry positions at **Blackstone, BCG and Google**. Frederik bought this research at Blackstone, and Soren sold it at BCG.

Our clients already include **two of the world's five largest PE funds** and several mid-market funds demonstrating the broad appeal of our technology.

**Ask:** Can you introduce us to private equity funds, hedge funds or private credit funds that need credible market intelligence? Contact us at [founders@diligencesquared.com](mailto:founders@diligencesquared.com)

https://youtu.be/DwNAEVXpv8c?si=qIkt0KSTylIdBg4T

**❌ The Problem**

Private equity funds spend **>$10B annually** on commercial due diligence. A standard engagement:

* **Costs $500K-$1M** per project
* **Takes 2-4 weeks** to deliver
* **Relies on junior Associates** often only 1-2 years out of university
* **Provides zero transparency** – no way to trace PowerPoint conclusions back to underlying evidence

The result: Funds delay diligence until the last minute because it's too expensive to do early or skip it entirely on smaller deals. In increasingly competitive capital markets, this creates a real disadvantage.

**✅ Our Solution**

Our AI agents autonomously conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights with **every claim linked directly to source transcripts**. The advantages are significant:

* **Speed & Scale**: Parallel process interviews in local language and instantly synthesize insights with AI.
* **Transparency and depth**: Trace any insight back to its underlying source, such as exact quote in interview transcripts. No black box, no "trust me" slides.
* **Cost**: Fraction of traditional fees—making diligence economical for deals that couldn't justify it before.

As one Managing Director at a PE fund told us: _"80% of the insight at 5% of the cost. It's a no-brainer for early-stage Commercial Due Diligence."_

**🤝 The Team**

Our team has spent years in private equity, consulting, and tech. We know what great due diligence looks like and how to automate it.

* **Frederik** was a Principal at Blackstone's Private Equity team across London, NYC, and San Francisco. He spent 6 years buying these $500K+ reports and knows exactly what investors find valuable versus unnecessary bloat.
* **Soren** was a Principal at BCG in NYC and spent 7 years leading commercial due diligence projects for the world's largest funds. He knows exactly which process and analytical steps can be automated.
* **Harshil** was a Software Engineer at Google, leading AI systems in Google Ads. He's a repeat founder with 10 years of experience building production ML systems and knows how to operationalize them at scale.

**🙏 Our Ask**

**Can you introduce us to:**

* Private Equity, Growth Equity, Private Credit, and Hedge Funds
* Portfolio companies or corporates that need market intelligence
* Deal professionals frustrated with traditional market due diligence

👉**Contact us at [founders@diligencesquared.com](mailto:founders@diligencesquared.com)** or visit [**www.diligencesquared.com**](http://www.diligencesquared.com)

launches.title: Aleph Kids — Your Child’s AI Language Buddy 🧑‍🎓
launches.tagline: Aleph Kids helps your child learn a new language while playing their favorite games
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Joseph](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hannim/), [Jaihee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kim-jaihee/), and [Dan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gy-han/), co-founders of [Aleph Lab](https://alephlab.ai/). 

We’re building your child’s AI language buddy in the games they already love, helping your child learn a new language while they play—think of it as Duolingo inside Minecraft.

https://youtu.be/d6zcIRppOQk

# **❌ The problem**

1\. Children on average play video games for 4+hrs/week. Many parents feel guilty about the screen time and worry that their kids aren’t being productive.

2\. Many parents want their children to learn a new language, but it’s challenging to have their kids sit through even a 30-minute class because it’s boring. Private native speaker tutors are expensive, costing at least $35/hr. 

# **👷Our solution**

We turn games into real language learning by bringing Annie inside Minecraft who secretly teaches.

Here’s a video of Emily, our customer, playing with Annie.

**Ask:** If you’re a parent or know one with a child learning English, start learning in Aleph kids today: https://alephlab.ai/

https://youtu.be/hAW5eWn4qhA

* Annie’s now taught over **2,000 sessions**.
* Many kids improved by more than **a grade level in just five sessions**. 
* We even convinced families to buy Minecraft for $30 to learn in Aleph Kids.

 

**Pedagogy**: Annie prompts kids to speak hundreds of words and absorb new vocabulary, and corrects their grammar in real time, helping them improve every time they play.

**Beginner-friendliness**: We provide real-time transcriptions of Annie’s speech to help beginners understand Annie and refer to sample responses to know what to say next.

**Curriculum**: We offer a variety of modules (custom maps with scenarios) where children can practice speaking across different situations.

**Safety**: Learning happens on a private server, where kids play safely with Annie, free from random strangers or unfiltered chats. Annie also speaks in a child-friendly tone.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

We’d love intros to:

* **Language experts or ESL teachers** who can help us design our language curriculum.
* **Minecraft content creators** who love sharing fun gameplay.
* **Minecraft builders or builder communities** interested in building custom maps.
* **Animators or creative studios** that can help us make animations of Annie

👉 Contact us at [contact@alephlab.ai](mailto:contact@alephlab.ai)

# **👬 The Team**

All four of us are immigrants who know how hard it is to learn a new language. To help kids facing the same challenge, we tutored English for years. It was hard to keep kids engaged with flashcards and textbooks. But, when we joined them in Minecraft and spoke only in English, they naturally absorbed new words and phrases. 

This was our “aha” moment that led us to build Annie. She’s better than us at English and Minecraft, and is always available. Kids even say they’d rather play with Annie than us, so we’re on a mission to bring Annie to children around the world.

launches.title: Amera - Automating health insurance claims processing
launches.tagline: Amera automates claims processing workflows for health insurance payers, cutting manual work and reducing cost.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Deep](https://www.linkedin.com/in/deepkkapur/) and [Louise](https://www.linkedin.com/in/louise-tanski/), co-founders of [Amera](https://amerahealthsolutions.com/).

**TL;DR:** Amera automates claims processing workflows for health insurance payers: 

* Reducing plan admin costs by 20-30%
* Processing claims in minutes vs weeks
* Providing members with clarity and confidence in what’s covered and what they owe

We are already working with payers representing tens of thousands of members, giving them access to more affordable and transparent care options.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2745859/a9f8a106-37a8-4025-84d7-96858702f15d)

https://youtu.be/iSqBPqwWwAA

**Healthcare in the US costs way more than it should.**

Health insurance costs are rising twice as fast as inflation. American families now pay over $30,000 a year for coverage they’re unhappy with. 160 million Americans get insurance through their employer, and to control these costs, many large companies (>250 employees) [self-insure](https://www.healthcare.gov/glossary/self-insured-plan/) - they pay employees' medical claims directly instead of buying traditional insurance from carriers like UnitedHealth or Cigna. But the infrastructure powering these plans is decades old - some core systems still run on COBOL. This legacy stack makes operations manual and expensive, blocking adoption of affordable plan designs or AI-driven automation that could lower costs.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2745859/82de5250-de61-4b34-9ab4-f0d48503615e)

**Amera is building the modern system-of-record for health insurance administration.** 

Amera converts messy claims data from any source into structured data that existing systems can use. From there, we automate repetitive back-office work - validation, reconciliation, and stop-loss reporting - cutting manual effort from hours to seconds and making the processes transparent for the first time.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2745859/2670349e-9739-426a-b8d2-1c6986a6edfc)

Why is this hard? Health insurance tech has loose standards. Every plan runs on bespoke systems that cannot talk to each other. Claims arrive in hundreds of formats - EDI, PDFs, fax, proprietary systems - making automation nearly impossible without a unified data layer.

We’ve built the most comprehensive set of schemas for healthcare docs, designed to map to hundreds of custom formats and be fully interoperable. This makes it easy for us to layer new automation on top of existing systems. 

**Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2745859/d1d0a543-8c24-4992-a152-a943133917c6)

We both went to Penn and later worked together at Rupa Health, where we saw firsthand how outdated health insurance infrastructure makes it nearly impossible to deliver affordable, flexible coverage. 

We’re second time founders that have built and exited companies in workflow automation and healthtech, and spent months working with payers and plan administrators before starting Amera to rebuild the foundation healthcare runs on.

**Our ask**

Connect us with decision-makers in the self-insured ecosystem - especially TPAs, stop-loss carriers, or benefits advisors.

launches.title: Caddy: The Voice Interface for Your Computer
launches.tagline: Changing how people work across their computer and apps with voice
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Connor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/connor-waslo/) and [Rajiv](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajivsancheti/).

We led Loom’s AI suite and saw firsthand how natural language was changing how people work. Now we’re building Caddy, the voice interface for your computer that lets you automate work across all your apps.

Join the waitlist at [trycaddy.ai](http://trycaddy.ai)

**Launch video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v1HwM9mBYHU

### **The problem**

Work today happens across a maze of apps. Slack for messaging. Linear for tickets. Gmail for communication. Calendar for scheduling. Every task requires jumping between tabs and tools.

Even with AI everywhere, we are still using the same old interfaces. Voice assistants like Siri or Alexa can answer trivia but cannot do real work. They do not understand what is on your screen, what app you are in, or what you mean when you say “follow up on this.”

The result is constant context switching, lost flow, and hours wasted on work that should happen automatically.

### **What we are building**

Caddy lives on your desktop and lets you operate your computer with your voice. It has two simple modes.

**Action mode:** You speak your intent, and Caddy takes action.

Ask Caddy to create a ticket in Linear, send a message in Slack, or schedule a meeting in Calendar. Caddy sees what is on your screen and connects it to your apps, so you can stay focused on the work that matters.

**Dictation mode:** Never type again

Write emails, respond to messages, or leave comments anywhere text input exists. It is a direct replacement for typing that works globally across your computer.

Together, these two modes let you automate work and control your computer completely with your voice.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2945950/d99dbe1c-8793-4405-a7ca-568f05c831fd)

### **Who Caddy is for**

We are starting with founders, operators, productivity power users and the voice first generation who spend their days moving between tools and losing time to repetitive work. If that sounds like you, we would love to get you early access.

To join our waitlist add your email at [trycaddy.ai](http://trycaddy.ai) or shoot us a message [founders@trycaddy.ai](mailto:founders@trycaddy.ai)

### **The team**

Before starting Caddy, [Connor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/connor-waslo/) and [Rajiv](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajivsancheti/) spent four years at Loom where they led product and design for Loom’s AI suite and core product.

* We built a Cursor-like interface that allows humans and AI agents to work together on multi-modal data, achieving 10-100x efficiency

launches.title: Brickwise - AI Property Manager 🏡
launches.tagline: Automating maintenance for landlords and property managers
launches.body:
Hey everyone[ 👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re[ Ismail](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeilani) &[ Elias](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eliaskassell/?miniProfileUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAABeEg0EB4O6J8hjKE8dqLAnLjFXI3sosGQs) - co-founders of[ Brickwise](https://www.brickwiseai.com).

# **TL;DR**

**Brickwise is building an AI property manager that automates maintenance for landlords and property managers.**

Landlords usually get into property as a way to make money. They quickly realise it requires a lot of work, so they hand things over to property managers. On average, 1 property manager is hired for every 120 properties. That’s just the cost of property management.

Brickwise is making it possible to deliver profits and margins that haven’t been possible pre-AI.

Our Launch Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aDJyMnw8jpE

**Ask:** Are you a landlord or property manager? Or, do you know landlords or property managers? I’d love to speak to them directly: [ismail@brickwiseai.com](mailto:ismail@brickwiseai.com)

---

# **Problem ❌**

There are 240,000 property management firms in the US. They spend \~$56bn per year on salaries to manage properties. This reality is true pretty much everywhere in the world. In Europe, 214,000 firms spend \~$35bn on salaries.

How are these salaries financed? On average, an owner has to pay 10% of their monthly rent (before mortgages, taxes, repairs) to property managers.

This represents half the problem (literally). 50% of landlords are so put off by the cost of using a property manager, they choose to manage it themselves.

Unfortunately, this just hasn’t been solvable before. The more properties you have, the more people you need. One person can only answer so many emails or respond to so many calls.

As a team, we’ve been there before, building a small property management firm overseeing 130 properties. We understand the nuances of managing properties, from maintenance issues to evictions.

We also understand why only now technology has made it possible to change this.

# **Solution ✅**

Brickwise will one day automate the entire property lifecycle. We’re starting by making the most labour-intensive part as automated as possible: maintenance.

**Part 1 - 24/7 support via call, email and text**

Tenants are given a phone number and email that they can contact 24/7 (you can also try it yourself!)

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/190230/ef9b52f3-74fb-4132-a7ac-b10c4fc328b7)

Our AI agent does more than just triage and arrange visits. It actually understands issues and suggests fixes on the spot.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/190230/106cee28-b84f-49cb-ac19-ecfc8c643333)

**Part 2 - Organising and arranging contractors**

Of course, not all issues can be resolved over call or text. Often, someone needs to take a look. This usually involves a series of phone calls between the property manager, the tenant and the contractor. When you’re managing thousands of properties, resolutions take time. Reasons include (but are not limited to):

* Someone’s out of office
* You’ve been assigned a new property manager
* The contractor didn’t pick up their phone (and your property manager forgot to call back)
* It’s a weekend and your issue isn’t urgent
* They’re getting multiple quotes because the repair is expensive

Whatever the reason, everyone is unhappy when things take long. The beauty of AI is its ability to speak to many people at the same time. This means as soon as our agent picks up an issue, it is able to contact dozens of contractors (external or internal) at the same time.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/190230/f8bbbc58-1056-4271-a561-5c56357a6f7b)

**Part 3 - Keeping everyone updated, like “real life read receipts”**

Property managers are always kept in the loop with everything the agent is doing, giving them the exact oversight they need. At the same time, tenants are always updated with how things are progressing. These systems are automated, and most importantly scalable. We can manage instant updates for thousands of tenants.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/190230/065b1dd8-e4e4-42f8-aee2-5be5f1c1facb)

launches.title: Hestus - AI for hardware development
launches.tagline: Hestus helps engineers work 2.5x faster with 4x fewer clicks
launches.body:
Hi YC!

This is [Kevin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-chu-11a4511/) and [Sohrab](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sohrabhaghighat) from Hestus and we are building an AI for Hardware Design. 

# **TL;DR: There is no such thing like code completion for CAD, so we built it.**

Our first tool, Sketch Helper, natively integrates into your CAD environment. It understands your design intent, and predicts your next move.

* Makes sketching **2.5x faster**
* Requires **4x fewer** clicks
* Accept suggestions with a single key stroke
* Over **1000 engineers** are already using it

[**https://youtu.be/-I6IZCwt-rw**](https://youtu.be/-I6IZCwt-rw)

# **Problem**

Mechanical engineers are fast at conceptual design but get buried in "click-work."  Getting a concept ready for manufacturing takes countless, manual and error-prone clicks to assign constraints and dimensions.

As one of our users said: 

> Only a third of my time goes into real design work. The rest is just clicking through sketches and dimensions, and I can only click so fast. 

# **Solution**

We built “Sketch Helper,” a copilot for sketching in CAD. 

It understands your design intent and proposes your next move, may it be adding constraints, missing dimensions, or even additional geometries to your sketch. You can preview any of the proposed changes in a red overlay and accept it with a single keystroke.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95212&key=user_uploads/295796/26c0f9a0-6a9e-43e5-abc3-aab8f5b9f773)

Next, we are going to expand into full 3D and build “**Mate Helper**” and “**GD&T Helper**” to help not just with design but as well as design for manufacturing.

# **The big vision**

The biggest problem in hardware is the silo between design and manufacturing, which leads to endless, costly iterations.

The push to reshore American manufacturing has hit a major bottleneck: we lack the deep bench of manufacturing experts we once had. As Tim Cook noted, the skilled tooling and manufacturing expertise is no longer concentrated here (https://youtu.be/_ng8xQ-SNGc?si=WzfP4aCJmec1lJo4&t=547).

Our AI learns design intent by observing an engineer's actions in CAD. By starting with sketching, we are building the foundation model that understands why a part is designed a certain way.

This is the key to an AI that can provide real-time manufacturability feedback, bridging the gap between design and manufacturing and automating the tooling design process.

# **Who we are why we are the team to crack this nut**

We’ve felt this pain firsthand. We (Kevin and Sohrab) were both early employees at Cruise. Kevin led the AV engineering team, scaling it from 20 to 300+ people. Sohrab founded the rocket company SpaceRyde (YC W19) securing millions in launch contracts and led laser tech development at Mitsubishi. We’ve built and shipped AI for self-driving cars, surgical robotics, and rocket launches. Now, we are fixing hardware development.

# **Ask**

* For everyone else: What CAD platform do you or your team use? Reach

  us out at [founders@hestus.co](mailto:founders@hestus.co). We are prioritizing our expansion based on your feedback.

launches.title: Lunavo - The AI assistant for trucking carrier operations
launches.tagline: AI that runs your backoffice - so your team can run logistics.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Niclas and Felix, and we’re launching Lunavo!

**TLDR:**

Lunavo is the AI assistant that automates the backoffice of trucking carriers so teams can focus on customers and growth.

_Launch Video:_

https://youtu.be/fKWHgdt8hv0 

**The problem:**

Trucking carriers coordinate complex operations to transport goods from A to B , but they spend most of their time on repetitive admin work like entering orders, updating portals, and checking systems. Most communication is still handled manually.

This creates two problems. First, teams waste hours on busywork instead of managing operations. Second, the noise makes it nearly impossible to spot issues that need attention until it's too late. A delayed pickup, missing document, or customer escalation only gets noticed when it's already urgent.

The real complexity isn't in data entry. It's in catching and resolving issues early: rerouting around delays, finding backup capacity, flagging exceptions before they cascade. Carriers need visibility and time to handle what matters, not endless manual updates.

We sat with dispatchers managing hundreds of shipments a day and saw their inbox and phone effectively act as their task managers.

·   Many handle between 50 and 100 emails per hour, and most of them are repetitive.

·   Teams constantly pull data from emails, PDFs, and portals into their Transport Management System (TMS).

·   They often jump between ten or more tools that don't communicate properly with each other.

Companies end up paying skilled employees to move data between tools instead of running logistics

**Our solution:**

Lunavo integrates into a carrier's existing systems as an AI teammate. When a new order arrives, it automatically extracts details, updates the TMS, and confirms with the customer. Dispatchers see: "New order from Customer X confirmed and scheduled."

**The system handles routine work while monitoring for exceptions** like delayed pickups, missing documents, or customer escalations, surfacing issues before they become urgent. It understands task dependencies and escalates only what needs human judgment.

Because logistics workflows often depend on implicit knowledge, our system can understand customer workflows and adapt to it. Our agents self-improve through dispatcher feedback, company documentation, and user-defined rules, automatically adapting to each customer's unique requirements without manual reconfiguration.

Lunavo manages to understand incoming documents, extract relevant information, challenges the inputs on plausibility and integrates them into the TMS. In case of anomalies, the system loops in the dispatcher:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/607a54fb-83cd-423d-8c36-312523817e4b)

**_Before Lunavo_**_:_ A driver is delayed. The dispatcher has to (1) log into the GPS portal, (2) inform the customer with an update, (3) manually update the TMS, and (4) update the customer's portal for delivery time. This takes up to 15 minutes of work.

**_With Lunavo:_** Lunavo detects the truck's GPS delay. It _automatically_ emails the customer, updates their portal, and sends a single notification to the dispatcher to keep him in the loop: "Driver 5 is delayed 30m. Customer X has been notified. No action needed."

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/bdb58f1b-2c10-4e29-b485-d64718f81c6f)

Lunavo helps trucking companies scale operations without scaling headcount.

**About us:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/531e2a61-c332-4ee9-ae0a-520a28e47341)

We're Felix and Niclas, founders of Lunavo. Together, we've spent the past years at the intersection of logistics and AI.

·   **Felix** worked with logistics and supply chain companies at McKinsey and later built a robotics logistics company in Germany, spending five years deeply embedded in the industry.

·   **Niclas** studied Computer Science at the Technical University of Munich and the University of Waterloo, focusing on AI security and applied machine learning

**Our ask:**

If you work in logistics or know someone running operations in road transportation, we would love to connect.

You can reach us at felix.loesch@lunavo.ai or visit [www.lunavo.ai](http://www.lunavo.ai).

launches.title: AirCaps - The AI copilot for in-person conversations.
launches.tagline: Bringing AI assistance to in-person conversations, overlaid onto your field of vision.
launches.body:
**TLDR;** **AirCaps is bringing AI assistance to in-person conversations.** 

Our AI-copilot provides live captions, translations, AI meeting notes and insights for in-person conversations in real-time. It's deployed as an app for lightweight AR glasses so you can see visual information overlaid onto your field of vision.

You can think of it like a Zoom AI meeting assistant or Granola, but for in-person conversations, and with the ability to proactively help you in real-time, not just after the conversation.

We’re building the capture and intelligence layer for the 216 billion daily conversations that happen face-to-face.

We’ve already transcribed 16,500 hours of in-person conversations and counting. Today, AirCaps assists with 11% of our users’ in-person conversations.

We did $93K in revenue in October and grew 6.5x from September while spending <$3K on marketing (and hit $70K in revenue in the first 2 weeks of November). Our power users average 6h+ daily usage and our day-30 retention is 91%.

We previously went viral (75M+ views on TikTok, 150K+ followers) and have been featured by The New Yorker, WIRED, and Forbes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95216&key=user_uploads/854295/06ddc792-97ec-4338-be78-adbcd7f493c1)

**The Problem**

The average person struggles to understand and retain 50% of in-person conversations, forgets 70% within 48 hours, and can't review any of it.

We have 20-30 in-person conversations daily, meaning humanity generates \~200B in-person conversations (on average 10 minutes, generating 36 billion hours of content) every single day.

While virtual meetings have captions, recordings, and hundreds of AI assistants, these in-person conversations remain completely unassisted by technology.

Why?

1. Form factor: There's no socially acceptable way to assist conversations in real-time. Phones kill eye contact, AirPods create audio-on-audio confusion, laptops are obvious.
2. Technical complexity: Real-world audio is fundamentally messier - background noise and overlapping speech make it exponentially harder than virtual meetings. Most companies give up at 80% accuracy.

[https://youtu.be/avyjB3LMTI4](https://youtu.be/avyjB3LMTI4?si=Mv9-h9PaKb5Yjx1M)

**Our Solution**

We're finally bringing AI to real-world conversations. We’re deploying our software on a discreet, socially acceptable, always-on, and hands-free visual interface: AR glasses.

Our earliest customers are people who need help understanding conversations (captions for real life) or translating languages for in-person business meetings, and meeting-heavy professionals - healthcare workers, executives, salespeople - who need real-time AI assistance during high-stakes conversations but can't use screens without breaking eye contact.

We’re building the killer app for the next platform: think Spotify / Instagram for phones before everyone had a phone.

AR glasses are the only form factor that works for in-person conversations: 

* Always-on recording without disruption
* Visual display in your field of view for real-time assistance (not just post-hoc)
* Hands-free mobility and greater environmental awareness
* Superior audio capture for better data ingestion
* Greater social acceptability compared to phones, headphones, or other wearables for meetings (people already wear glasses)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95216&key=user_uploads/2955798/21e61d6f-e1c0-4361-af8f-af21fb3b87e3)

**The Team**

Madhav and Nirbhay have been obsessed with voice technology and AR for 11 years and met at an AR hackathon in the summer of 2024.

Madhav (CEO, Yale CS) built his first Google Glass apps at age 13 and his first Jarvis voice assistant for RPis at age 14. He researched audio AI at MIT Media Lab, where he was part of the team that built the world's first live AI-human musical co-performance. His Yale thesis focused on extracting clean transcripts from noisy multi-speaker audio.

Nirbhay (CTO, Cornell CS) started building voice AI on smart glasses in high school, developing an emotional support tool for people with Autism. He's previously built voice and conversational AI platforms for therapy as the first hire at several early-stage (including YC) startups.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95216&key=user_uploads/2955798/be18a62d-22bf-493e-a76c-b222b16a933d)

**Why Now**

There’s never been a better time for us: AI is becoming faster & more accurate for speech, and people are starting to default to AI assistance for conversations: 3 out of every 4 professionals uses AI notetakers for virtual meetings. And not to mention: Meta, Apple, Google are investing $200B+ to ensure everyone wears AR glasses.

**Ask**

If you know doctors who use medical transcription services, or organizations that rely on field sales (real estate, home services, retail), please connect us!

launches.title: Lemma: Continuous Learning for AI Agents
launches.tagline: We enable AI agents to continuously improve by turning real user feedback into automated prompt optimizations.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

Lemma is the first evaluation + observability platform built not just to measure performance, but to improve it automatically. We help AI agents learn from real user feedback and production data, closing the loop so your prompts and agents continuously optimize themselves over time.

**Launch Video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E4_v-pY_4fs

Hey everyone! We’re [Jerry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jerry-n-zhang/) and [Cole](https://www.linkedin.com/in/colegawin/), co-founders of [Lemma](https://www.uselemma.ai/) (YC F25).

**The Problem:**

**AI agents don’t learn from their mistakes. In fact, they get worse with use.**

In production, prompts and agents continuously degrade due to real-world input drift (new user behaviors or unseen edge cases). Agent performance can often **drop \~40% in a few weeks**, and suddenly what worked in testing breaks in front of customers.

When that happens, engineers are forced to dig through logs, collect failing examples, and manually tweak prompts rather than building core product features.

**Solution:**

That’s why we built **Lemma: the first end-to-end system that closes the loop between agent deployment and improvement.**

**Here's what that means:**

**Step 1:** Lemma detects failed outcomes directly from live traffic, and it automatically identifies the exact cause in an agent chain.

**Step 2:** Lemma alerts you, and with one click, it runs targeted prompt optimizations to fix the failing behavior without any manual tracing or guesswork.

**Step 3:** We give you back an improved prompt and automatically open a PR in your codebase so your prompts can live where you want them. Alternatively, you can also fetch your prompt from the Lemma dashboard.

**Plus, Lemma provides all the LLM eval and observability features you rely on, just reimagined for continuous learning:**

* Data-ingestion pipeline to bring your existing eval sets and automatically flag inconsistencies and gaps

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1798805/4f862c09-dce0-48da-91fe-1a152a5d82da)

* Prompt editor and inference support for any closed & open-source model for prompt iteration.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1798805/92464a28-ab54-4511-bc79-fd3e4f9d4823)

* Agent tracing observability with live drift detection, regression alerts, and performance visibility across real user interactions.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1798805/2b82ecee-1965-4fc0-831d-36b76db3f064)

Teams using Lemma cut manual prompt iteration by 90%, resolve production drifts in minutes instead of days, and improve model performance \~2–5% every optimization cycle.

**Our Story:**

We met freshman year at USC and have been building together ever since instead of going to classes.

Before starting Lemma, we were engineers at two high growth, AI-native startups: Tandem (AI for healthcare) and Chipstack (AI agents for chip design). At both companies, setting up evaluations looked like clunky Retool dashboards and multiple engineers manually tweaking experiments. We built internal systems that automated both running the evaluations themselves, as well as the error-driven feedback loop. The result: 2x accuracy improvement and speed of iteration.

We soon realized every AI company was reinventing the same internal tooling in-house. So we left college, joined YC, and are now bringing continuous learning infrastructure to everyone else.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1798805/53754495-215a-47aa-884d-bae4a59f9a68)

**Ask**

**Try our platform** - If you’re building with LLMs and run a ton of prompt or eval experiments, we’d love for you to work with us.

**Introductions** - If you know a Head of AI/Eng or CTO at a pre-seed to Series A startup, we owe you lunch :)

Please reach out at [jerry@uselemma.ai](mailto:jerry@uselemma.ai) or book a live demo on our website [uselemma.ai](http://uselemma.ai). All help is appreciated - thank you!

👉 **Other AI tools generate clips** — **Flick lets you direct Films**

👇 **All launch video content made with Flick** by ourselves | 🔊+🎧 recommended

https://youtu.be/daVI0yscN94?si=iEhip6dPkn8E4rwu

👉 Make your first film: [flick.art](https://flick.art/?invite_code=YCLAUNCH) with code: YCLAUNCH

### **Problem**

Many AI tools can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to making high-quality films, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow.

Creators think very differently from consumers. Creators think in a non-linear way — moving back and forth freely to iterate, making decisions at every step. To direct a film, creators need not just visual and character consistency, but also character movement, shot angles, camera language, and emotional arc.

### **Solution**

Flick puts creative power back in the hands of filmmakers:

1. **Infinite Canvas + Chat**

   An infinite canvas where users upload or generate text, images, and video as connected nodes. We integrate multiple models, but instead of prompt-to-video, we let filmmakers think in terms of scripts, characters, and scenes and give them a natural “chat to create on canvas” experience.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2980671/b8812b5c-bb57-4071-9c06-8fe98632f7d0)

2. **Editing while creating**

   Creators like to go back and forth when making shots, so we built editing tools directly into the canvas. So, they can define exactly what kind of shot they want to add or delete to ensure a stronger narrative.

3. **Studio + Perplexity for film scenes**

   No one creates from nothing, we’ve needed inspiration since the beginning of humanity. That’s why we’re building [Studio](https://flick.art/studio/experiments-too-boring?from=home), where we produce our own [AI films](https://flick.art/studio/short-films-a-letter-in-early-fall?from=home) and collaborate with leading filmmakers to share their behind-the-scenes workflows as reusable canvases and templates for our community members.

[**Ray**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ruiwang3/) was a founding engineer at Instagram AI team, who helped build the first version of Instagram Stories, launched it and helped grow it from 0 to 400M DAU in 2018. launches.title: Digipals - AI-native Group Chats that get you outside
launches.tagline: Where AI makes us more social
launches.body:
Social media has become more media and less social. When I open up Facebook and Instagram, I don’t see any of my friends on it anymore - it’s one third ads, one third content from strangers on the internet, and one third AI slop. My friends are no longer on social media - I either meet up with them IRL or catch up with them in group chats.

https://youtu.be/KW2tjLl6sxM 

What if your group chats could help get you a reservation... and help you split the bill? Now it can.

We're building an AI-native group chat app that helps you hang out with your friends more. Your AI agent (digipal) knows your location, calendar, relationship history, and photos. It talks with your friends' digipals to coordinate IRL hangouts automatically - suggesting times when everyone's free, finding nearby restaurants and coffee shops, making reservations with AI calls, splitting bills from receipts, and nudging you to share photo memories after hanging out. 

Right now, coordinating hangouts with friends takes too much effort. We're removing that friction so you can spend less time planning and more time actually having fun IRL.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7bae7c14-2266-4d71-82e2-f23716cf4f2a)

**Where We're Going - The First AI-Native Social Operating System**

Digipals work through AI widgets that pop up right in your group chat when you and your friends need them. Talking about dinner? The restaurant widget appears. Someone sends a receipt? The bill split widget shows up. You never have to leave the group chat to coordinate.

We're starting with widgets that make it easier to hang out IRL - restaurant reservations, movie/concert suggestions, flight/hotel bookings, bill splitting, and sports scores. Here's some sneak peeks:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/91296545-05f9-4057-b324-b600168547b9)

Then we're adding widgets that help you stay close to your friends and make new ones - relive memories from fun times together in the past, post memes/articles/reels your group would actually find funny, surface life updates worth celebrating, and connect with friends of friends.

Eventually, anyone can build AI widgets for Digipals. Your group chat becomes the social operating system, and the widgets are the apps that enhance human connection.

**Team**

[Peggy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/peggy-wang-ai/) cares deeply about human relationships. For over nine years, she's grabbed dinner monthly with the same friends at Madras Cafe in Sunnyvale - the restaurant their group chat is named after. She's a second time founder who worked on the Metaverse at Meta Reality Labs, where she believed that the future of social connection was in virtual worlds and games. Now, she's convinced the future is simpler - it's showing up IRL.

Mathew made a hit solo game called [deadshot.io](http://deadshot.io) which has over 2M+ monthly active users. He enjoys connecting with others through playing music and video games, and joined the team to help make the future a little less lonely for everyone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7ee11258-ded8-466d-a9e5-ac5819801ad0)

**Asks**

* Please join the waitlist at [www.digipals.app](http://www.digipals.app) - we’ll be launching soon 👀 If you know Peggy personally, you can DM/text her to get early access :)

launches.title: Saffron Health: AI-powered care coordination for primary care
launches.tagline: AI agents that fully automate specialist referrals
launches.body:
Primary care providers make over 100 million referrals to specialists every year, leading to tens of millions of hours in manual coordination work. We built AI agents to automate the entire specialist referral process for primary care groups.

[**https://youtu.be/LqlDMjHARl0**](https://youtu.be/LqlDMjHARl0**)

## **Problem**

Managing specialist referrals is one of the most time-consuming workflows in primary care. Staff must manually copy data between systems, complete prior authorizations, call specialists to verify information and request medical records, and coordinate with patients.

Many clinics are forced to hire or outsource their referrals, but they’re still understaffed. As a result, referrals often never get sent, are returned for missing authorizations, or go to out-of-network providers. Nonetheless, poor referral management has significant consequences:

* In value-based care models, specialist routing has a massive impact on medical spending. Out-of-network costs and unnecessary procedures are major cost drivers.
* Groups that depend on federal funding or grants, like FQHCs, can lose funding due to poor referral follow-through.
* Patients who experience delays in care because of referrals are likely to churn and find a new primary care provider.

## **Product**

We partnered with a network of rural health clinics in west Texas to understand the specialist referral process. We started by manually handling referrals, then built AI agents to automate the whole workflow. Our agents are live across the network, where we’ve:

* Sped up referral processing time by 82%
* Found available appointment times that were 55% sooner
* Led to 44% fewer referral kickbacks

## **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1184840/3e4114e5-24ec-4c32-af9c-37c3848f300c)

Tanishq Kancharla has worked in startups throughout his career. He was a product engineer at Shortwave, leading development on their iOS and Desktop apps, used by tens of thousands of people. Prior to this he double majored in physics and computer science at Carnegie Mellon.

Michael Kronovet was technical lead overseeing Palantir's work with the US State Department, quadrupling annual revenue without increasing headcount. Previously, he built causal inference models at a healthcare startup. He graduated in 3 years from Carnegie Mellon with a BS in statistics and machine learning.

**Our Ask**

If you know anyone who works in or adjacent to primary care we’d love to be connected!

* Some examples: people who work in MSOs, ACOs, primary care groups, RHCs, FQHCs or payor/insurance groups.

launches.title: Oversteer - The Most Reliable Browser Agent for Any Web Task
launches.tagline: Turn any website into a reusable API
launches.body:
**_TL;DR_** Oversteer is building browser agents to automate web tasks and turn them into reusable, deterministic APIs. You can integrate the API into any system and automate/integrate any website or portal. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IZCy2r-rs7s

# **What’s the insight?**

Across industries, teams still outsource repetitive web tasks — logging into portals, downloading files, submitting forms, extracting data — to human labor, spending millions of human labor hours. Traditional browser automation tools exist, but they’re **unreliable, expensive, and non-deterministic**. Companies and users want something that just works - a reliable agent that can execute their workflow end-to-end deterministically that works correctly every time, and actually replace human work. 

# **What did we build?**

Oversteer is an **AI browser agent** that automates any website or web portal from a simple prompt. It generates **deterministic scripts** that run like APIs — **reliable, reusable, and self-healing** when websites change. Because they don’t rely on LLMs at runtime, they’re **fast, consistent, and cheaper** than traditional browser agents.

# **How it works:**

**Step 1:** Understands and records a user’s web workflow from just a prompt.\
**Step 2:** Generates a deterministic automation script from the workflow.\
**Step 3:** Handles anti-bot detection, CAPTCHA solving, and automatic login with 2FA.\
**Step 4:** Runs as a reusable API and connects to systems like Zapier, n8n, and app builders like Lovable, v0.\
**Step 5:** Automatically adapts when websites update, ensuring the automation keeps working.

---

# **The Team**

**Tim Jang** – Founder. Previously built multiple consumer apps with millions of users. Developed large-scale web automation systems to extract real-time data on millions of consumer products, and is now bringing that technology into a product that anyone can use.

---

**TLDR:**

User research is expensive, slow, and hard to do well. Expected Parrot makes it radically cheaper, faster and easier.

We let you simulate customers with AI agents—run surveys, test pricing, get reactions to new features—before spending money on conventional research or building the wrong thing. Our tools make it easy to optimally combine human and AI generated data to run the best possible versions of your experiments.

[Expected Parrot: Simulate your customers.](https://youtu.be/wVggRUnIdnA)

**How it works:**

Turn your customer data into AI agent personas, then run them through surveys just like you would with real people. Get instant results you can compare directly to human responses. E\[P\] provides the open source tools and services to validate these simulated results to increase confidence.

We offer a web app (for PMs, designers, and researchers) and a Python library (for data scientists who want full control). Surveys are the interface—expressive, familiar, and perfect for comparing AI to real human data.

**Use it for:**

* Pricing strategy: simulate hundreds of variations, estimate revenue
* Product testing: find confusion before you build
* Message testing: iterate on positioning at machine speed
* Policy and legal: explore stakeholder reactions to different arguments

**Key features:**

We handle all the plumbing—prompt engineering, async execution, structured parsing, caching, API management. Researchers focus on questions, not debugging Python or juggling API keys. 

With conventional research, you have an idea, you design a survey, launch it, wait 2 weeks and then learn you didn't quite ask the right question—and you spent several thousand dollars. With E\[P\], you can design a survey, generate agents, run the survey and get results in seconds.  

**Traction:**

We’re working with tech companies like Upwork, a global consulting firm, and users in banking, entertainment, consumer products, government statistical agencies, and non-profits. Our open source tools are being taught in business and CS programs at many universities.

launches.title: Efference - Helping robots see like humans do
launches.tagline: Efference is building the most intelligent robotic camera on the market -- at half the cost.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95175&key=user_uploads/1945409/8214e17c-76b2-4c77-9b83-f11af13ff298)

Hey YC, I’m Gianluca. I’m building robotic cameras (stereo cameras) that treat vision as a software problem, not a hardware problem – just like humans do.\
\
We are actively taking pre-orders with delivery in March: https://efference.ai/preorder

[**https://youtu.be/0v0p2t3y4fI**](https://youtu.be/0v0p2t3y4fI)

Many robotics founders that I talk to are frustrated with current stereo cameras. They are expensive, require calibration, and still produce unreliable depth measurements despite their costs. Vision shouldn’t be an additional bottleneck when training robotic policies is already hard enough.

Our insight is that humans don’t have precise sensors: our eyes are noisy and imprecise but we run extremely sophisticated algorithms on top of them. Robotics already embraced this philosophy for arms (_cheap hardware + great algorithms_ → \[Zhao et al., 2023\]). We’re applying it to cameras by developing better algorithms.

What we built:

* A 3D perception model that combines stereo triangulation + learned priors about objects and environments.
* It runs in real time (unlike current neural depth approaches).
* We are distilling the model into our own hardware and shipping model wrappers for Realsense/ZED cameras so you can run these cameras better.

Check out the designs (going into production soon):

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOmf4k2ZwaY**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOmf4k2ZwaY)

**Does it work?**

Self-Driving: [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0f058JAk64A**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0f058JAk64A)

Robotic Manipulation (via Functional Manipulation Benchmark): [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GyV12gqGOMY**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GyV12gqGOMY)

And many more demos coming to the YouTube channel: [https://www.youtube.com/@Efference](https://www.youtube.com/@Efference%5C)

**Why do we need this?**

Converting a vehicle to full autonomy can cost upwards of **$100,000**. The economics are terrible: the sensor stack dominates lifetime cost, keeping cost-per-mile high and slowing deployment. A stereo-vision stack like ours cuts that cost by **10–100×**. Lower integration cost → cheaper replacements → larger fleets → autonomy that scales. We know we can drive a car using a stereo camera because that is what humans use. It’s just a matter of getting the camera to work as well as the one humans have.

The same dynamic applies to humanoids, perhaps at an even greater scale. Companies like Unitree ship tens of thousands of robots every year, all with stereo cameras, and consumers often complain about quality. We’re building a camera that is both **affordable and usable**, so teams can actually build with it. As humanoid production scales to millions of units per year, we hope to be the camera that scales with it.

In urban drone environments, GPS fails. Reliable RGB-D depth enables SLAM, safe navigation, and collision avoidance; critical for companies like Skydio operating in urban valleys. Again, drones are another vertical that requires thousands of cameras per year that are cheap and effective.\
\
**Additional Background**

Any two-dimensional image is consistent with an infinite number of possible 3D worlds. “Seeing” is not just recording sensory input but resolving ambiguity; selecting the _most probable_ world given the available evidence **\[Born & Bencomo, 2021\]**.

Humans and nearly every other mammal have evolved the same solution to this problem over the past 500 million years of evolution: stereo triangulation + data-driven inference. We integrate every available depth cue – shadows, perspective, occlusions, and much more – along with what we know about objects and the environment to accurately represent 3D scenes and act accordingly.

Robots do not do this, but they need to.\
\
**Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95175&key=user_uploads/1945409/2474fb24-fae7-4604-a549-2a875fad6452)

I spent the past four years at Princeton (on-leave from PhD) studying foundational topics in machine learning and neuroscience. I funded my research by writing two successful NSF grants to build biologically-inspired vision models based on the **fruit fly connectome** where the general research direction for myself and certainly my collaborators was the question of **“how do we make this fruit fly live inside a computer simulation?”**

Prior to Princeton, I spent two years at Harvard Medical School studying visual decision-making in primate models and publishing influential theoretical work on **dopamine’s role in schizophrenia and its effects on visual perception**. I did my undergraduate degree in Biochemistry and got to do some cool non-vision work at the NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, figuring out a **new way of converting CO2 into O2 on Mars** that recycled water and did not require heat (e.g. MOXIE).

Generally, I like to work on really hard problems.

**The Ask**

If you’re a roboticist, I’d love to learn what vision requirements matter most to you. If you know teams in autonomous vehicles, drones, or humanoid robotics, and believe this product is cool, sharing / intros would mean a lot.

We are actively taking pre-orders with delivery in March: https://efference.ai/preorder

Thank you — Gianluca.

**\[Born & Bencomo, 2021\] [https://karger.com/bbe/article-abstract/95/5/272/47302/Illusions-Delusions-and-Your-Backwards-Bayesian](https://karger.com/bbe/article-abstract/95/5/272/47302/Illusions-Delusions-and-Your-Backwards-Bayesian)**

**\[Zhao et. al., 2023\] [https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.13705](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.13705)**

launches.title: Nucleo: Automated Cancer Diagnostics
launches.tagline: We help oncologists and radiologists extract insights from CT scans to characterize and treat tumors.
launches.body:
[Nucleo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gR84avz0zkc)

**👉 [Learn more about Nucleo](https://nucleoresearch.com/)**

**👉 [Contact us](mailto:angelica@nucleoresearch.com)**

### **Problem**

Cancer is not only a biological disease; it is a **logistical failure**.

Cancer is responsible for 1 in 6 deaths \[1\]. ≃ 20% of those deaths happen simply because proven treatments start too late. The latest registry data show that the median **diagnostic interval** in the United States is about 36 days \[2,3\], while the median **time-to-treatment** initiation is roughly 32-41 days (≈38 days on average) \[4,5\]. So a typical American with cancer waits ≈ 9-11 weeks (65-80 days) before therapy actually starts.

A four-week delay after diagnosis adds 6–13% relative mortality; risk rises another ≈8 % for each additional 4 weeks (e.g. 12-week delay ≈ +26-30 % mortality) \[6\].

By automating key tasks in the oncological workflow we plan to cut 9-11 weeks to ≤ 10 days.

### **Solution**

The doctor imports the CT scan. Our AI-powered software automatically extracts key oncological metrics such as sarcopenia, body composition assessment, lesion volume, and target vs. non-target lesion classification.

Some results:

* Our segmentation is 2,500x faster than the manual one.
* We achieved State-of-the-art performance in sarcopenia detection.
* Our validation studies show a 98% agreement between Nucleo and medical experts.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1402780/31d40150-99ff-47c2-84d9-f8afa4191632)

### **Our Team**

[Angelica](https://www.linkedin.com/in/angelica-iacovelli-490a8a1a7/) was previously researching at Stanford University, where she worked on cardiovascular modeling, simulating blood flow dynamics using GNNs, LSTMs, and Transformers. The models are now part of NVIDIA’s scientific libraries. She holds BS+MS in Mathematical Engineering from Politecnico di Milano and completed a research exchange at IIT Madras. In 2025, she was recognized as one of the 11 most influential Italians under 35 in software.

[Luca](https://www.linkedin.com/in/luca-pegolotti/) is a researcher in Applied Mathematics and AI for healthcare. He holds degrees from Politecnico di Milano (BSc) and EPFL, Switzerland (MSc and PhD), and conducted research at the Stanford School of Medicine during his PhD and postdoctoral studies. Before founding Nucleo, he was part of Apple Health AI, where he worked on physics-informed machine learning.

\[2\] Caplan, L. Delay in breast cancer: implications for stage at diagnosis and survival. _Front. Public Health_**2**, 87 (2014).

launches.title: SF Tensor - Infrastructure for the Era of  Large-Scale AI Training ⚡
launches.tagline: We tweak kernels to squeeze out extra speed, hunt down the cheapest GPUs across every cloud and make your models train on any hardware. Train frontier models without the DevOps nightmare.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 

We’re [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benkoska/), [Tom](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tomkoska/) and [Luk](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lukkoska/) - co-founders of SF Tensor. 

**TL;DR:** We let AI researchers forget about the infrastructure layer and focus on their research. 

We automatically optimize kernels to run faster, find the cheapest GPUs across every provider and migrate your jobs when spot instances fail. Training AI should be about AI, not DevOps. 

**_Ask:_** Know anyone training or fine-tuning AI models? We’d be grateful for an intro! Reach out to us at [founders@sf-tensor.com](mailto:founders@sf-tensor.com). 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95098&key=user_uploads/801244/994bfb29-1b66-4506-86bd-8b3d0197eff4)

## **The Problem**

Training AI should mean developing smarter architectures and finding better data. But right now, it doesn’t. Teams waste their time on everything but actual research: 

* Optimizing code so that training runs don’t drain the bank 
* Fighting cloud providers and scrambling for GPU availability 
* Making distributed training work with reasonable MFU (=cost efficiency).

This drives up costs, frustrates everyone and kills velocity. Infrastructure has inadvertently turned into the limiting factor for AI research labs, and it’s killing progress.

We experienced this first-hand developing our own foundation models – what we expected to be AI research, experimentation and iterative improvement turned out to be an ugly mix of writing CUDA, debugging driver mismatches and optimizing inter-GPU collective operations. That’s why we decided to solve the infrastructure layer, to allow other researchers to **focus on research, not infrastructure**.

## **Our Solution**

SF Tensor is the "set it and forget it" infrastructure layer for anyone training or fine-tuning AI models. Hook up your repo, pick your GPU count and budget, and we deal with the rest:

* Our automatic kernel optimizer analyzes your architecture and tunes execution for any hardware (NVIDIA, AMD or TPUs). No more having to drop down into custom CUDA because PyTorch doesn’t understand memory topology. 
* We find the cheapest available compute across all clouds for your specific requirements and launch your training run. 
* Automatic Distributed Training allows you to scale from 1 to 10,000 GPUs without having to change your code or killing your MFU 
* Everything else that you shouldn’t have to think about: Spot instance migration? Handled. Monitoring? Baked in. Logs and artifacts? Done.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95098&key=user_uploads/801244/89170605-19e4-4029-87dd-7a3fa85cc9df)

## **The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95098&key=user_uploads/801244/519e2798-579a-43e1-8c96-28f3be87a392)

We’re 3 brothers that have been working on Artificial Intelligence together for years, most recently training our own Foundational World Models. SF Tensor was born out of our own needs as AI researchers scaling up training runs to thousands of concurrent GPUs.

Ben has been publishing AI research since high school, solo-training models across 4,000 GPUs as co-PI on a 6-figure grant.

Tom and Luk (twins btw) have been doing AI research for years, from starting college in parallel to high school at age 14 to finishing their BSc in CS (at age 16).

## **Compute should be boring. Let’s make it boring.**

Try us right now at [sf-tensor.com](http://sf-tensor.com) or contact us at [hello@sf-tensor.com](mailto:hello@sf-tensor.com) to see how we can help with your infra pains.

launches.tagline: Remix your music without knowing how to DJ
launches.body:
We’re [Joe](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joekndy/) and [Jonah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonahsiegle/), cofounders of [Mixy](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mixy-make-mashups/id6739403586).

Mixy lets anyone remix music without knowing how to DJ. We’ve optimized our own local models to produce real time, high quality mashups at no cost.

⁕ Add your songs

⁕ Instantly blend vocals and beats

⁕ Play and share your mashup anywhere

**Since Launch**

⁕ $200k in donations, $20k MRR since launching our subscription last month

⁕ #1 in Music and #3 Top Free overall on the App Store

⁕ 1.5M users in 3 months

⁕ 18M mashups made and growing

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95158&key=user_uploads/42474/cd3aa913-8172-4a48-a472-4d21f4e03eb8)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-W_6p6g2CdE

**What’s Next?**

⁕ Instantly enable people to create full length mashups and remixes through our own music mixing model

⁕ Create the best listening experience where all of your favorite songs combine and blend into one another in unimaginable ways

⁕ Instantly pay out artists and creators per second on plays

⁕ The music industry will unlock billions in value and Mixy will change how we experience music forever

**Our Story**

Joe and Jonah met as tech YouTubers in 2008, and began building apps together in 2009. They’ve worked at Apple, Instagram, and Skillshare. Recently Jonah led mobile at Tithly (Stripe’s 8th largest customers), and Joe founded a consumer social startup acquired by CoinList ($100M Series A), where he led product.

At the end of 2024, we started Mixy was started as a fun way for fans to make mashups of their favorite songs. Prototypes were shared on TikTok, which led to over 350k pre-orders before launch. Mixy debuted on June 19th, hitting #1 in Music and reaching #3 overall in the App Store. Since then, more than 1.5M users have created and shared over 18M mashups.

---

**Problem & Vision**

We believe Remixing is the new Shuffle.

Fans are searching for infinite ways to experience their favorite artists, and the tools to remix and create derivatives are far too complicated.

For artists, derivative musical works are being created at an exponential rate, but artists aren’t getting credited, and billions of dollars are being left on the table.

Mixy flips this model. We celebrate artists by letting fans directly manipulate and share versions of their songs. Every time a fan shares their creation, the artist is automatically credited and their work is distributed more widely. Because Mixy owns the creation layer, attribution is native. We auto-credit every source track and pair it with a music-first social network built for playback and discovery.

The future isn’t millions of irrelevant AI songs, it’s millions of recognizable songs evolving through thousands of shared versions.

If we truly succeed, Mixy will be the platform that redefines music in the age of derivative works. What TikTok is to YouTube, Mixy is to Spotify.

We’re tackling this because we love music, see a timely problem, and bring a world-class background in creative tools and consumer social.
