👋 We’re **Yuma (YC W23)**, an AI support platform for e-commerce, and today we’re launching one of our biggest updates yet: **Flows**, a visual automation builder for ecommerce support.

**Flows** expands Yuma’s AI agents’ capabilities with a visual builder for explicit, deterministic steps. You can now combine process-based AI agents with the reliability of a flow for faster, more precise CX automation.

### **Why we built it**

For more than 2 years, Yuma has helped merchants automate customer support using our natural-language AI Agents builder, resolving over 5 million tickets to date. But as merchants grow, they need more control, advanced workflows, and precision while staying flexible and easy to maintain.

That’s why we built **Flows**, a visual, step-by-step builder that adds structure, clarity, and reliability to AI automation.

### **What it does**

Flows let merchants visually define how an SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) runs, step by step and action by action. Each step is visible, enforced, and powered by a mix of good old hard code and LLMs.

Flows combine quick ramp-up and adaptability with _strict step-by-step control_ where it matters.

With Flows, you can:

* Build if/then logic visually with guaranteed execution
* Combine AI conversations and deterministic rules
* Review and debug complex automations in minutes
* Gather clear insights and metrics on automation paths
* Use hooks and ordered API & CRM calls for full consistency

### **Why it matters**

Flows make automation more reliable and easier to maintain. It brings three major advantages:

**Step-by-step precision:** Every action runs exactly as designed, with enterprise-grade reliability you can trust.\
**Visual clarity:** Instantly see, review, and debug every step of your automations, no guessing or black boxes.\
**Hybrid flexibility:** Combine LLM adaptability with structured, reliable workflows for the best of both worlds.

The result is higher accuracy, fewer escalations, and faster resolutions, all in a visual format you can refine in minutes.

launches.title: Lakonia: AI-Powered Tactical Command and Control Software
launches.tagline: Lakonia is building the next generation of command and control software to enhance the operations of first responders, law enforcement, and the military.
launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Gordy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gordysun/) and [Justin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justin2028/). We’re excited to publicly announce what we’ve been building at Lakonia.

**TL;DR:** Lakonia’s AI Command and Control platform acts as a tactical assistant by listening to radio communications and using AI to automatically extract key intel, map units, and recommend actions. We give first-responder, law enforcement, and military teams the situational awareness they need to make better, faster decisions.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DrVPw4CVzxU

# **The Problem:**

Police and military command and control technology is terribly archaic and outdated. Commanders in a central post rely almost entirely on fragmented radio chatter to understand complex situations, forcing them to build a mental picture from scratch on every incident/situation. And current software is woefully outdated - unintelligent and unintuitive.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2944902/726ea501-6ff8-446d-9b30-a7fc9a3028fd)

These issues only get exacerbated during multi-agency operations, where different departments (like SFPD and CHP), military branches, or even allied forces cannot communicate seamlessly. Communication siloes, different cultures of radio etiquette, chains of command, etc. all make command and control even more difficult.

And while at times this is just a daily annoyance, when it’s a matter of life or death, these communication breakdowns become **fatal**.

# **Lakonia’s Solution:**

Olympus is an **intelligent, real-time co-pilot** that plugs into existing radio networks, transforming chaotic voice chatter into a **clear, actionable operational picture.**

Our AI engine works in real time by:

**- Transcribing and diarizing** every transmission to identify who said what

**- Parsing transmissions** to analyze and automatically tag critical information - for example, pinpointing addresses on a map, logging license plates, and identifying calls for backup

**- Highlighting** the most urgent events and suggesting relevant next steps, **turning raw audio into structured intelligence**

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2944902/c78d42a9-f060-4024-a5e8-aac1466ad28d)

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2944902/4275d0a3-6853-4605-a15d-494eb39b5657)

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2944902/23e29921-35dc-449d-aa21-ea8880019c80)

We’ve also built a **mobile “Pip-boy” platform** for operators to access so that they can also be aware of what’s going on aside from their radio. This dual approach dramatically reduces the cognitive load on personnel at every level, empowering teams to make faster, smarter, and safer decisions when it matters most. 

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2944902/5f679af9-289c-4cfb-80f3-fc8ba440b2e0)

For dispatchers and commanders, our software means less time spent clarifying details or trying to keep track of officer availability and statuses. For operators in the field, our software means less time waiting for dispatch to respond and better situational awareness in tactical environments.

We built Olympus with a deliberate focus on security, performance, and scalability. We rely on **no third party APIs**, allowing us to even operate in denied environments through mobile platforms. We are at FedRamp and CJIS-equivalent levels of compliance, utilizing AWS GovCloud for services. All the models we use are open-source models we fine-tuned ourselves.

This modular foundation allows us to rapidly integrate new capabilities. Our future roadmap includes advanced features like live drone feeds, computer vision analysis, and real-time language translation.

# **About Us:**

We’re two Stanford engineering students who left after our freshman year to go build the tools that our public safety and military teams deserve. In designing and building our platform, we were heavily inspired by RTS video games we’ve played as intuitive interfaces for delivering critical information to players. We wondered why law enforcement and the military don’t have similar tools and decided to go build them ourselves.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/2944902/353cbfd1-d5fd-42e6-9d2d-5abbe867d7bc)

# **Our Ask:**

We are looking for introductions to innovative leaders in public safety and defense who want to utilize our platform.

Our ideal contacts are decision-makers (e.g., Chiefs, Sheriffs, Commanding Officers, Heads of Security) in:

* Law Enforcement (Municipal Police, Sheriff's Offices, Transit/Campus Police)
* Military (Infantry, Artillery, Armor, National Guard, Special Operations units)
* Emergency Services (Fire, EMS)
* Private Security (Corporate campuses, large venues, critical infrastructure)

Hi YC!

If you **edit videos or work with post-production teams**, get in contact and we’d love to get you started.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1n3oEbTVB-c

## **The team**

We’ve scaled consumer apps (games, AI study tools) to 2M users, and video marketing has been central to that growth. When we talked to businesses about their marketing, we kept hearing the same problem over and over: they had incredible footage from events and productions, but it took weeks to turn into content. Smaller teams simply didn’t have the time to edit this footage either. We dove deeper into post-production workflows and realized the entire industry was drowning in grunt work.

Previously, we’ve worked on computer vision research at Brown and software engineering research at UW, as well as AI infrastructure at Apple and marketing for Vectara.

Professional video editors spend 90% of their time on work that has nothing to do with creativity.

They're scrubbing through hours of raw footage, hunting for specific moments, organizing clips, and fighting archaic software — while the actual artistry gets squeezed into whatever time remains.

We're **Erik, Aryan, and Victor;** we built **Narrative** to fix this.

## **What Narrative does**

Narrative automates the repetitive work:

* Add b-roll to the timeline intelligently for an interview, based on the transcript
* Search terabytes of footage using natural language and instantly find similar clips
* Pull selects and create stringouts for social media and long form edits
* Perform batch iterations through a conversational chat window

Professionals at corporate post-production teams, wedding videographers, and sports teams already use Narrative to cut hours from their workflow.

We will also be launching video editing and clipping APIs for businesses soon.

launches.tagline: Scientific discovery platform that reduces months of manual research work to hours.
launches.body:
Hello YC! We’re [**Ayush Garg**](https://linkedin.com/in/ayush4921) and [**Ryan Mccarroll**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-mccarroll-/) from [**AnswerThis**](https://answerthis.io/)**.**

**TL;DR**

AnswerThis analyzes all the relevant research in your field to answer complex scientific questions with line-by-line citations. Over 250,000 researchers have saved months on their literature reviews using AnswerThis, making it one of the fastest-growing apps in the research space.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nKTS2QWnjqw

**Problem**

Over 5 million research papers are published every year. Researchers spend months crawling through academic databases to conduct their literature reviews. By the time they finish, new literature has often been published.

When they finally have their literature collected, they must read dense papers while taking detailed notes. If they want to explore a new aspect of the topic, they have to repeat the process, making it difficult to advance science quickly.

Once they have their notes, synthesizing the findings into a detailed literature review requires precision, highly accurate citations, and concise but informative scientific writing. 

This entire process is extremely time consuming, and takes away from actual experimentation. 

**Solution**

Enter your question, select your filters, and AnswerThis searches multiple academic databases to answer it with exact citations to every relevant paper. The literature review that took months, now takes minutes.

You can save the sources, analyze them, and write with our AI assistant on a single platform while collaborating with your team. 

We also integrate with tools researchers already use, like Zotero and Mendeley, and we offer advanced exports that correctly carry over citations and equations.\

**The user is able to verify each source, and save it to their AnswerThis library:**

launches.title: Unsiloed AI: Make Unstructured Data LLM-Ready
launches.tagline: We build APIs to parse multimodal unstructured data and convert it into LLM-ready formats. Our vision is to make documents as computable and queryable for AI Agents as your data sitting in an RDS.
launches.body:
Hey YC, we are [Aman Mishra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aman005/) and [Adnan Abbas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adnan-abbas-903b711a2) from [Unsiloed AI](https://www.unsiloed.ai/).

**TL;DR:** _Unsiloed AI is building the most accurate APIs for ingesting multimodal unstructured data like PDFs, PPT, DOCX, tables, charts, and images, and converting it into structured Markdown and JSON for downstream LLMs and AI Agents._

We are already processing millions of pages of complex documents each week for Fortune 150 banks, NASDAQ‑listed companies, as well as early‑stage startups in accuracy-sensitive domains like finance, legal, and healthcare.

https://youtu.be/ULDK5dgfgzM

**The Problem**

More than **80% of enterprise data is multimodal and unstructured**. AI teams spend **6+ months** building accurate document‑ingestion pipelines that keep breaking.

* From the tons of open‑source solutions out there, it’s still tough to achieve superior accuracy on even mildly complex cases.
* Traditional OCRs are static and break with changing layouts.
* LLMs, although good at comprehension, suffer at **deterministic extraction**, making them unreliable for accuracy‑sensitive domains like finance and healthcare.
* Early‑stage vertical AI teams end up becoming **document AI companies**, reinventing the wheel, as evident from **300+ conversations** we’ve had with AI teams of all sizes.

**Solution (What we built)**

We combine **vision models** with **OCR‑based models** to accurately extract information from complex documents.

**1) Pre‑processing & Segmentation**

* We segment data into **texts, tables, images, and plots** using specialized models for each task.
* We use a **heatmap‑based chunking** technique that first generates **pivot elements** from the document. Pivot elements are the elements of importance, e.g., **numbers and merged cells in tables**.
* This chunking strategy ensures all related pieces of information are preserved in the **same chunk** (e.g., a table spanning multiple pages, rows split across pages), while unrelated information is split across chunks. The result: retrieval feeds **only accurate, complete‑context chunks** to LLMs.

**2) Dual‑Stream Representation**

Post pre‑processing, we pass the segmented chunks through **two parallel streams**:

* **Data Stream:** preserves the **extracted content**.
* **Layout Stream:** preserves the **actual layout & hierarchy** (indentation, alignment, clause/sub‑clause structure).

This matters because the data is not just text and numbers the **structure carries meaning** (e.g., a right‑aligned cell in a financial table or the way clauses/sub‑clauses are arranged). The dual stream captures both **semantic content** and **structural cues**.

**3) Domain‑Specific Decoder**

* A decoder consumes both the streams and structures the outputs as per the required **JSON schema** or **Markdown**.
* We incorporate **domain‑specific ontologies** (finance, healthcare, legal).
* An in-built **RL pipeline** to train the decoder when outputs involve internal terminology that is hard to capture using a general LLM.
* We generate **confidence scores** for each extracted item; **low‑score items** are collected over time to run **fine‑tuning jobs**

We can run all of this under fully air-gapped on-premise environments as well for privacy-sensitive verticals.\
\
**Here are some sample outputs generated by our Vision Models:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95076&key=user_uploads/879419/fdfed5e7-994a-47d3-9357-b20b1d2a3b67)

PIE Chart formatted markdown

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95076&key=user_uploads/879419/7e78481c-6898-4bfe-a6d8-c49ada7cef52)

JSON output from handwritten, scanned docs, along with confidence scoring and citations.\
\
**Our Progress:**

We are already processing millions of pages for Fortune 150 banks, NASDAQ‑listed companies, as well as early‑stage startups (including 10+ YC startups) across finance, legal, and healthcare. On public benchmarks, we consistently outperform solutions from LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and [**Unstructured.io**](http://Unstructured.io)**,** among others.

Here is a representation of the volume of pages we have processed, stacked on top of each other.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95076&key=user_uploads/879419/849f06b2-5d8d-4c77-8b73-40f6661a3f92)

**Our Ask:**

Parsing **PDFs, images, PPTs,** or **Excel files** for your **Vertical AI** use case or **RAG** pipeline? Give [**Unsiloed AI**](https://www.unsiloed.ai/) a try. We turn months of ingestion work into one API call for every document type.\
\
Sign up on [**unsiloed.ai**](http://unsiloed.ai) to give it a try (no credit card needed)\

launches.title: Locus – Payment infrastructure for AI agents
launches.tagline: Give AI agents spending power without losing control
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95052&key=user_uploads/2656097/b9c1fd17-80cf-4a84-b400-34fc2577f0db)

Hey YC! We’re Cole and Eliot, and we’re building **Locus,** which is payment infrastructure for AI agents. We help developers safely connect agents to funds and define exactly how those funds can be used, with agent identities, budgets, permissions, and full audit trails.

# Our Story

We came to this problem from opposite ends of the same frontier. Cole spent last summer at Coinbase, building B2B payment products and seeing firsthand how control and compliance shape financial infrastructure. Eliot was working at Scale AI, maintaining data pipelines for the world’s largest AI labs. He watched as models began to tackle sustained, open-ended tasks. Both of us realized that as agents grow more capable, the next bottleneck isn’t intelligence: it’s _trust_.

Payments are a web primitive. And as we task agents with increasingly long and noisy workflows, they will _inevitably_ need to make payments. This might mean ordering parts to complete a physical repair, paying another agent for design work, hiring a contractor for a one-off task, or making micropayments to access private data.

But today’s payment rails were built for humans, not autonomous systems. There’s no safe way to say, “this agent can spend $500/day on these vendors,” and have that rule enforced. No audit trail showing which agent authorized what and why.

# Make Them Pay — Today!

Recently, OpenAI, Google, Visa, and Coinbase all released their own agentic payment protocols. But while everyone’s racing to build the next payment rails, nobody’s building the _control_ layer: the foundation that actually gives you power over how your agents use these rails. **Locus is building exactly this.**

Locus currently supports USDC on Base, with support for ACH and wire transfers coming soon. You can give your agents spending power and start building today.

# Demo

We built a micro-task payment system where an agent evaluates work submissions, scores quality, and pays contributors automatically. You set rules like "max $50 per payout, $500/day, must include a justification." The agent handles the rest. No manual approval needed, but you have full audit trails showing who got paid, when, and why.\
https://youtu.be/ICSzoZTq9JE

# Join Us!

If you build agents, join our beta and help shape the future of agent-driven finance! Learn more and sign up at [paywithlocus.com](http://paywithlocus.com). We'll give you $10 in USDC to experiment with.

We’re also building a community of builders in the space and would love for you to join. If agents with spending power sound at all interesting to you, join here to stay in the loop: https://discord.gg/TGnjUceXwE

# [https://youtu.be/6rntHGR475U\\](https://youtu.be/6rntHGR475U%5C)

# Contact Us

Email [founders@paywithlocus.com](mailto:founders@paywithlocus.com), or find us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/paywithlocus/) or [X](https://x.com/PayWithLocus).

launches.title: Moss: Real-time Semantic Search for Conversational AI
launches.tagline: We help conversational AI teams turn lagging, robotic interactions into natural, human-like experiences through sub-10 ms semantic search.
launches.body:
Hello YC! We’re [**Sri Raghu Malireddi**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/r4ghu) and [**Harsha Nalluru**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/imharshanalluru/) from [**Moss**](https://usemoss.dev/).

### **TL;DR**

Moss is a high-performance runtime for real-time semantic search. It delivers sub-10 ms lookups, instant index updates, and zero infra overhead. Moss runs where your agent lives - cloud, in-browser, or on-device - so search feels native and users never wait. You connect your data once; Moss handles indexing, packaging, distribution and updates.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95036&key=user_uploads/2412081/c21db6f6-b453-40b6-a15d-5654971ab2ab)

### **The Problem**

If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt it - that awkward pause when your agent lags or hesitates. The illusion of conversation breaks, and suddenly it feels less like talking to intelligence and more like waiting for a page to load.

The culprit is almost always retrieval. Every query hops across networks and cloud databases, adding seconds of delay. As usage scales, those small lags snowball into lost users, rising infra and egress costs. Teams spend weeks rebuilding embeddings and indexes, tuning search infra just to get “good enough” answers instead of focusing on what actually matters: building great AI experiences!

### **Solution**

Moss puts real-time semantic search in the same runtime as your agent and application, so you can -

* **Keep retrieval close** - embed & index right alongside your agents (docs, chat history, telemetry).
* **Answer in <10 ms** - local lookups, zero network hops.
* **Manage at scale** - store, sync, and distribute indexes with our managed data layer at [**https://usemoss.dev**](https://usemoss.dev)
* **Drop-in SDKs** - [**JavaScript**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@inferedge/moss) and [**Python**](https://pypi.org/project/inferedge-moss/).

### **Our Story**

Moss founding team knew each other for 8+ years and bring deep expertise in machine learning, high-performance computing and developer experience.

Sri was an ML Lead at Grammarly and Microsoft, where he shipped LLMs and personalization systems used by millions of users across Office, Bing, and Grammarly. His work on personalization drove 300% retention growth for Grammarly Keyboard and scaling models to 40M+ DAUs. He has published at top ML conferences such as ACL and holds multiple patents in real-time ML.

Harsha was a Tech Lead @ Microsoft, where he architected the core stack of the Azure SDK, powering 400+ cloud services and 100M+ weekly downloads on npm. He also built foundational open-source tools and large-scale test automation systems. Earlier, ranked among the nation’s best in the Olympiads like the IMO and UCO, he combines analytical rigor with large-scale engineering expertise.

The idea for Moss came from our deep frustration with how slow “intelligent” systems actually felt in practice. While building large-scale agentic systems at Microsoft and Grammarly, we kept hitting the same wall - retrieval lag that made even the smartest models feel lifeless. Through evolution, humans are wired to expect instant replies; when AI hesitates, it breaks the illusion of intelligence. We started Moss to fix that by collapsing the multi-hop retrieval stack into a real-time, local-first runtime that lets AI think and respond at the speed of thought.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7-PrunZVXTo

### **Who is it for?**

* **Platform/Founding Eng:** Drop in realtime semantic search. No new service to run.
* **Infra Leads:** Local retrieval to slash p95 and egress.
* **Agent/Voice PMs:** Hit <10 ms so conversations feel natural.
* **Security/Compliance:** Keep sensitive context local (offline-ready).
* **Data/ML Eng:** A/B embeddings & index configs on your corpus - fast.

### **How to onboard?**

* Login to the portal - https://usemoss.dev 
* Start a new Project, create an index either through the portal or [JavaScript](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@inferedge/moss) and [Python](https://pypi.org/project/inferedge-moss/) SDKs

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95036&key=user_uploads/2412081/ecd79cf8-972e-4233-9987-e015ad49abd8)

* Using our SDKs - **init**, **load** and **query** indexes in **sub-10ms**.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95036&key=user_uploads/2412081/60e783b7-d7d3-411a-91fd-05cbd678130a)


### **Our Progress**

We’re seeing strong inbound pull from the market with 6 enterprise design partners and 3 paying customers actively building their products around Moss’s core tech, with 7 more actively evaluating. We’re working closely with Voice AI orchestration companies like Pipecat ([Daily.co](http://Daily.co)) and LiveKit, embedding Moss at the core of their real-time retrieval and context pipelines. Usage and revenue have been growing \~100% week over week, and Moss is quickly becoming the foundational layer teams rely on to make AI feel instant, contextual, and truly responsive.

### **Ask**

* Building in Conversational AI and Voice AI?[ **Use Moss**](https://usemoss.dev) to bring real-time semantic search inside your agents to production
* Developers -[ **Get free access**](https://form.typeform.com/to/XWeuMaar) to experiment with Moss and help shape the future of real-time conversational AI.

Our contact information -

* Email - [**founders@usemoss.dev**](mailto:founders@usemoss.dev)
* Website - [**https://usemoss.dev**](https://usemoss.dev)
* Book a demo - [**Calendar Link**](https://cal.com/srimalireddi/30min)

launches.title: Dome - A unified API for prediction markets
launches.tagline: Trade and analyze data across multiple platforms at once
launches.body:
Hi everyone - we’re [Kurush](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kurushdubash/) and [Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunal-roy-772a0672/) - and we’re building [Dome](http://domeapi.io) 👋

# **TL;DR**

**Dome is a unified API for prediction markets, like Polymarket and Kalshi.** We allow users to trade and analyze data across multiple platforms at once. Over 50+ developers are already building on Dome.

**Ask:** Building or trading in prediction markets? Contact [kurush@domeapi.com](mailto:kurush@domeapi.com) or [DM](https://x.com/kurushdubash) us.

https://youtu.be/eYWb3hpxSnE

**Prediction Markets**\
Prediction markets are a new financial instrument that combines news, polls, and expert opinions into a single value that represents the market’s view of an event’s odds. In the past few years, platforms like Polymarket and Kalshi have processed tens of billions in volume, giving real-time insight into collective public belief.

# Problem

_Fragmented_**\
The same markets are scattered across multiple platforms**. Fragmented formats and liquidity make them difficult to analyze or trade efficiently.

_Siloed Data_**\
Accessing reliable data is a challenge.** Every platform exposes different pieces of information, in different formats, leaving traders without a unified historical view.

_Infrastructure_\
**Primitive tools build primitive products.** Developers do not have the adequate infrastructure to grow this ecosystem. 

# Solution

**One Market View**\
Dome unifies prediction markets across platforms into a single, consistent interface.

* Matches **identical markets** across multiple platforms
* Streams **real-time data** through one API 
* **Integrate once** to access every platform

launches.title: Sciloop: The AI Scientific Researcher
launches.tagline: Come up with novel hypotheses, run experiments, analyze results, and write the paper — all automatically.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: We’re making the AI that does your research for you.[ Book a call.](https://calendly.com/osman-sciloop/30min)**

Hi.

We’re building **Sciloop**, a platform that automates the entire scientific research loop from hypothesis generation to experiment design, execution, analysis, iteration, and drafting real research papers.

https://youtu.be/GNM8iA6p9Ao

**Our Story:**

We’re Bilal and Osman, IPhO medalists and former MIT students with 4 years of experience applying ML in various research domains. While working at MIT CSAIL, we saw how large language models could help with literature review and even generate new hypotheses. Stanford’s recent study ([Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.04109))  showed that LLM-generated hypotheses can be more novel than those from domain experts. We saw the same in our own work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94951&key=user_uploads/2718484/3a420779-570b-4a69-b3ee-628644695a3e)

But after generating ideas, everything slowed down. We spent hours designing experiments, writing code, debugging compute setups, and rerunning failed jobs that could crash after 12 hours. Even with tools like Cursor that helped us code faster, the overall loop from idea to insight was still painfully manual. Researchers everywhere face this same bottleneck.

So we asked ourselves: what if the research loop itself could be automated?

So we built **Sciloop**. It takes a research intent — a question or hypothesis — and automatically designs, runs, and monitors experiments in parallel on our own managed cloud compute. It tracks metrics, analyzes results, recommends next steps, and finally drafts a paper summarizing methods and findings. Sciloop turns days of busywork into hours of progress.

Our goal is simple: **to completely automate scientific discovery**. The next decade will see a century of progress packed into a few years. As AI grows smarter and more accessible, its biggest impact will be speeding up science — finding new cures, discovering better materials, and driving breakthroughs in physics and math.

That’s our north star. But we’re not waiting for the future. We’re helping ML researchers move faster **right now**, automating the parts of their workflow that slow them down most. Sciloop is already being used in MIT research groups and by early partners working on real ML problems.

If you’re a company, research lab, or ML team struggling with model performance, experimentation speed, or scaling research, we’d love to work with you. Our goal is to deliver concrete improvements on your research challenges today.

🚀 **The Ask - Let’s Make Research Self-Improving!**

If you’re working on ML research that could move faster, **book a quick chat** at https://calendly.com/osman-sciloop/30min or email us at [**team@sciloop.dev**](mailto:team@sciloop.dev).

We help brilliant research ideas stop gathering dust. This is for anyone who:

* Runs **university or industry ML labs** drowning in experiments.
* Is a **research student** buried under mountains of code and papers.
* Leads a **company dreaming of R&D** but lacking scientists or resources.
* Has a **head full of creative ideas** but no time to bring them to life.

Let’s collaborate and accelerate your research—together.

\[1\][ Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas? A Large-Scale Human Study with 100+ NLP Researchers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.04109)

launches.title: Rovi Health: Text-based healthcare that slashes employer health spend
launches.tagline: We deliver high-quality, affordable healthcare to employees through text. Employers cut 10-20% of their annual spend. Employees get concierge healthcare they love.
launches.body:
# **⏳TL/DR**

Rovi helps employees access high-quality, cost-effective healthcare. We text employees the best in-network options at exactly the right moment, and handle all the complexity.

* Our AI-enabled virtual care treats common conditions quickly over text or video.
* For complex care, our AI agents search across all in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, then handle scheduling and logistics.
* Employees get rewarded for choosing high-value care through copay reimbursements and waived deductibles.

Launch video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mKNB0CF8_9Y

# **⚠️ The Problem**

Healthcare costs are crushing employers. 2025 is seeing a 9% rate hike, the worst in a decade. A 1,000-person company now faces over $1M in cost increases annually, compounding.

Employers’ only options are to cut benefits or redesign their entire plan. Both take months and frustrate employees.

What if Employers could offset these costs by adding benefits instead?

## **🤨 How is this possible?**

**Price and quality have no correlation in healthcare:**

* The same MRI: $700 at an imaging center vs $2,500 at a hospital. Same network. Same machine.
* The same knee surgery: $7,000 at a surgery center vs $25,000 at a hospital. Same surgeon. Often better outcomes at the surgery center.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94971&key=user_uploads/1230817/7a7a2b27-4c82-410c-9744-82a5af6b1cc2)

**So why does everyone end up with the expensive option?**

1. **Hospitals own the referral pipeline.** They consolidated most primary care practices. When your doctor orders a procedure, their systems automatically directs it to their expensive facilities.
2. **Shopping is impossible.** Prices are hidden, provider directors outdated, quality is opaque. And when you're sick, calling twelve clinics is the last thing you want to do.

**Rovi does the hard work.** Our AI agents analyze terabytes of pricing data, research every provider's quality metrics, and surface options matching each person's preferences for cost, convenience, and availability. Making good healthcare decisions drives down costs for both the employee and the employer.

# **🎯 Impact**

We save employers 10-20% on healthcare spend while improving care outcomes and delivering a health benefit that employees love.

We've already signed contracts to roll out to thousands of employees across multiple employers for the 2025-2026 plan year.

## **🙏🏾 Our ask**

1. **Employers:** We have two final Q1 spots for self-funded employers. Introductions to employer benefits teams, brokers, health plans, and TPAs are welcome. Reach out to [santosh@rovihealth.com](mailto:santosh@rovihealth.com).
2. **Individuals:** [**Join our beta**](https://rovi.health/) to try our AI care concierge. Rovi will find you great in-network doctors whenever you need care. Virtual care coming soon.

## **👬🏾 Our team**

We're brothers on a mission to build AI-native health insurance that members love.

**Santosh** was previously building Cedar's affordability products, scaling to millions in ARR by closing enterprise deals with the country's largest hospital systems. Before that, he led a 30-person GTM & Customer Success team at AngelList. He’s also a licensed health insurance broker.

**Tarun** built foundational AI models to predict extreme weather events at UChicago, where he earned a Master's in AI and high-performance computing. He has a B.S. in biology from Cornell, and is obsessed with using AI to solve healthcare's messiest data problems.

launches.title: Hypercubic – AI to maintain and modernize COBOL/Mainframes
launches.tagline: Capture and preserve decades of institutional human expertise from your mainframe systems.
launches.body:
# **TLDR ⚡️**

Hypercubic helps Fortune 500s understand, preserve, and modernize their critical mainframe systems. These are the COBOL systems from the 1960s that still power banking, insurance, retail, airlines, government and more.

# **Asks 🤝**

We’d love intros to:

* CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, or Heads of Modernization at Fortune 500s, especially in banking, insurance, logistics, and airlines.
* Any enterprise running COBOL or mainframe workloads.
* Systems integrators or consultancies that work on mainframe maintenance or modernization.

# **The Problem**

**70% of the Fortune 500 enterprises still run on mainframes and COBOL originally built in the 1960s**. These systems run the global economy, yet they’ve become black boxes. The engineers who built and maintained these systems are retiring and what’s left behind is systems that are opaque, brittle, and nearly impossible to modify without risking production outages.

This institutional knowledge is a ticking time bomb:

* **Vanishing Expertise:** The handful of engineers who understand the nuances of decades-old COBOL, JCL, and CICS systems are retiring or leaving.
* **Failed Modernizations:** Without this deep expertise, modernization projects often fail, costing millions and creating brittle, unmaintainable systems.
* **Inadequate Documentation:** Static, outdated documentation can't explain _why_ a system was built a certain way or how to debug a critical failure at 3 AM.

Current "AI for code" tools analyze repositories, but they can't capture the unwritten rules, historical context, and architectural reasoning that lives only in the minds of the most senior engineers.

**The result: trillion-dollar infrastructure with no surviving map or maintainers.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/40a1cc5c-9859-4df9-8dc4-50e9c7f9ab8f)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/0ec58980-1b71-49bd-bdd7-6bd6fa926bc4)

# **Our Solution**

**Hypercubic is building an AI-native maintenance and modernization platform that learns how legacy mainframe systems _actually work_ — and captures the human reasoning behind them.**

We start with:

* **HyperDocs**, which ingests complex COBOL, JCL, and PL/I codebases to generate accurate high-fidelity documentation, architecture diagrams, and dependency graphs — giving teams an instant, living map of their systems.
* **HyperTwin**, which captures the institutional expertise of retiring engineers by observing their workflows, screen interactions, and verbal reasoning. It builds a _digital twin_ of the experts on how they debug, architect, and maintain these systems in practice.

Together, HyperDocs and HyperTwin form an institutional knowledge layer that links _code_, _systems_, and _human reasoning_ — **enabling the next phase: autonomous AI agents that can safely maintain and modernize critical mainframes end-to-end.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/d9b867b9-cb41-4152-bc37-4dd215405d92)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/a4cebb8f-05e5-44b6-9e1b-9c932fdc7dbb)

# **Why now?**

**We’re at the tipping point of one of the largest knowledge transitions in human history.**

For decades, the systems that run our banks, airlines, and governments have quietly relied on a generation of engineers whose expertise lives only in their minds — and that generation is disappearing (baby boomer generation).

As the “silver tsunami” accelerates, **we’re watching trillions of dollars of institutional memory vanish line by line.** Every retirement is a lost encyclopedia. Every undocumented function is a forgotten decision that once held a company together.

At the same time, AI has finally evolved from pattern-matching to _reasoning_, giving us the tools to preserve and replicate that expertise before it’s gone.

**For the first time, we can capture how systems think, not just how they run turning decades of fragile human memory into living, searchable intelligence.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/fd8874f2-b27c-4a7e-a8b9-a64325efe3d3)

📩 You can reach us at [**team@hypercubic.ai**](mailto:team@hypercubic.ai) or learn more at [**www.hypercubic.ai**](http://www.hypercubic.ai)

What is up! We’re [Arman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/armankumaraswamy/) and [Rohil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohil-ag/) - cofounders of [The Context Company](https://thecontext.company)

**TL;DR**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/129e5656-94c6-42e6-a2ba-6ac545b0ef94)

Setup takes under 10 lines of code, and we now support Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph, with more frameworks coming fast.

https://youtu.be/5FVesVO9egg

**The Problem**

AI agents often fail quietly. Traditional observability tools only show latency or stack traces. They miss the silent layer of failures that happen inside reasoning steps or tool calls.

Most teams end up waiting until users report issues, and by then, it’s already too late. As a developer, I know you’ve been there scrolling through endless logs, trying to piece together what an agent actually did and why it failed (because trust us, we have too 🙏🏽).

**We’re rethinking observability from the ground up and making silent failures a first-class primitive in agent monitoring.**

**Our Solution:**\
Instead of just visualizing traces, we analyze them and detect reasoning breakdowns across runs. In addition to traditional metrics like latency, cost, and token usage, The Context Company surfaces failures in a clean, developer-friendly dashboard.

**Our Progress**

* Framework support: Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Instant setup: <10 lines of code - no refactoring or modifying your agent needed. This is what it looks like:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/560baa96-5818-4d20-bf82-43f2d3775ca3)

* Local debugging: Run observability locally on your laptop for real-time trace analysis.
* Dashboards: Full visibility into agent runs, tool calls, latency, costs, and semantic failures.

Arman and Rohil have been best friends since 6th grade (8+ years now!). 

Arman optimized the public-facing AI agent at Mintlify, where he cut failure rates by 82%, and worked with enterprise design partners to build custom agents. Rohil worked on Gmail Intelligence at Google, reducing hallucinations in intent detection by 27% across 26B+ daily emails.

**SellRaze can sell your stuff from just a pic, using AI.** Over 200,000 users have already listed 500,000+ items, with 2,500+ added every day.

https://youtu.be/Nl3zOYSLT_Q

**Our Story**

In high school, I (Jeff) was a reseller. Instead of paying attention in math class, I would spend hours trying to buy limited-edition Jordans.

At first, I thought getting inventory was the hard part. But as I scaled to hundreds of items, I discovered the real bottleneck was actually selling them.

Every item took 30+ minutes: research comparable prices, write descriptions, take photos, fill in product details, post across eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Facebook Marketplace. Then do it all over again for the next item.

I had thousands of dollars in inventory just sitting there because the listing process was killing me.

**We realized this wasn't just a reseller problem.** The average American household has $4,000 in unused stuff lying around, yet most Americans who've sold online quit after just a few listings. Valuable inventory sits unsold, not because there aren't buyers, but because the listing process is too manual to make sense. With AI, this is finally changing.

🗣️ **What we’ve built**

SellRaze turns a photo into a live listing **in seconds.**

Point your camera at anything. Our AI identifies the item, determines what it's actually worth, selects the best photos, fills in every detail, and lists it across multiple marketplaces, automatically. Once it sells, we arrange free pickup from your door.

The entire process, which used to take 30+ minutes, now takes seconds.

* **Reliability:** setup custom guardrails that automatically detect non-compliant messages and proactively fix them before they’re sent to the lead

launches.title: Parrot 🦜: TikTok for language learning
launches.tagline: Turn doom scrolling into fluent Spanish with short, addictive videos designed to keep you hooked, but smarter.
launches.body:
[https://youtu.be/2e7qK8pPn2M](https://youtu.be/2e7qK8pPn2M%5C)

When our co-founder and CTO, Erik, told us he wanted to build another language app, we weren’t convinced.

He had already taught himself Spanish, French, and Italian in a year, but we asked:

“Why would we compete with a $15 billion giant?”

“How did Duolingo make hundreds of millions and still get no one fluent?”

We had worked on a few startups together before, so we knew Erik wouldn’t let go of the idea easily. Then Julia joined us. We’d met in a university entrepreneurship class where we built a pharmacy voice assistant. It worked - but none of us cared deeply about it. After a few false starts, we realized we wanted to build something that actually mattered to people - and to us.\
\
**The research**

Before writing a single line of code, we did the homework.

* We downloaded and used 52 language learning apps. Every single one.
* We interviewed 65 learners across Reddit, Discord, and our own circles.
* We studied Comprehensible Input - the most research-backed method for language learning, developed by Dr. Stephen Krashen at USC: learn through listening and context first, just like a child.

That’s when we saw the gap. The market leader wasn’t helping people go from beginner to fluent. The problem wasn’t motivation - it was that no one had built a mobile-first, science-based product that actually made learning feel natural.

**The first test**

We built a simple MVP, a video player with captions - and went to a local university. Standing outside a Spanish 101 classroom, we stopped 20 students and showed them Parrot V0. We asked one question: “If this helped you understand Spanish videos effortlessly, would you pay $30 for early access?”

60 percent said yes - on the spot. That was the moment we knew we might be onto something.

**Why we’re building Parrot**

Parrot makes learning a language as fun and addictive as scrolling TikTok. Every swipe exposes you to real-world Spanish videos you can actually understand - powered by the science of Comprehensible Input.

We started this because learning a language shouldn’t feel like homework. It should feel like discovery. Like travel. Like connecting with someone new.

\
🦜 Try Parrot → [https://www.parrotapp.com](https://parrotapp.com/)

launches.title: Vogent Turn: State-of-the-art Turn Detection for Voice AI
launches.tagline: Stop interrupting; teach your AI when to wait, and when to speak
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Vogent-Turn-80M is a state-of-the-art turn-detection model that detects when users are done speaking with extraordinary accuracy, so your voice AI can stop interrupting.**\
\
https://youtu.be/XQeSUc2ID6g

What makes conversation feel natural isn't just what we say; it's knowing when to speak and when to listen. Current voice AI systems struggle with this fundamental challenge, either interrupting users mid-thought or waiting awkwardly long after they've finished. The problem? Existing turn detection relies on either audio-only signals (missing semantic context) or text-only analysis (losing critical vocal cues). When a user says "I'm flying from San Francisco..." are they pausing to think, or done answering? Audio and text alone can't tell; but humans know instantly.

**Introducing Vogent-Turn-80M**. Vogent-Turn-80M solves this by doing what humans do naturally: processing both how you're speaking and what you're saying simultaneously. Built on a streamlined 80M parameter architecture, our model fuses acoustic features from audio with conversational context from text, enabling it to understand that "123 456" with rising intonation means more is coming, while "I'm departing from San Francisco" is incomplete when asked about two airports. This multimodal approach achieves 94.1% accuracy while running in just \~7ms on a T4 GPU—fast enough to feel completely natural in real-time conversations.

The result? Voice agents that finally feel like talking to a human. No more frustrating interruptions. No more awkward pauses. Just natural, flowing conversation that responds at the right moment, every time.

Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/vogent/Vogent-Turn-80M

GitHub: https://github.com/vogent/vogent-turn

Blog Post: https://blog.vogent.ai/posts/voturn-80m-state-of-the-art-turn-detection-for-voice-agents

**TL;DR** Mulligan is an end to end AI automation platform for commercial insurance brokers. Cuts time spent on quoting, policy checking, proposals and more by 90%.\
Start for free at [usemulligan.com](http://usemulligan.com)

[Check out our launch video](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13cMUq8gAs5q-ZjXVqoS7SLv7pAC1ljYF/view?usp=sharing)!

# **Intro**

I’m Aman and we’re building Mulligan, the world’s first end-to-end AI automation platform for commercial insurance brokers. It automates Quoting, Policy Comparison, Proposals, Commissions and more. We work with dozens of brokers and have helped all of them scale their businesses without adding more employees.

# **Problem**

Selling and servicing commercial insurance is a complicated process to begin with, and the manual paperwork involved makes it difficult to scale profitably. Brokers have to spend hours reading lengthy documents, navigating ancient portals and formatting documents to fit into their internal systems.

Existing automation tools typically only address narrow workflows and do not integrate with each other, which means that automating a brokerage involves juggling multiple solutions and integrations.

The end result is that brokerages spend hundreds of hours every week, and billions of dollars annually, on non-revenue generating tasks and outsourcing.

# **Solution**

Mulligan assembles submissions, generates quotes from carrier portals, compares quotes and policies, generates proposals and handles commission statements in minutes, without needing your hands-on-keyboard. Here’s what it can do:

### **Quoting**

Quote from one of the largest selections of commercial lines insurance carriers for Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Business Owners’, General Liability and Trucking policies. Do so with minimal data entry and largely without human intervention. This makes it easy for an agent to get a more complete view of the market, do less data entry and spend more time with their customers.

To use it, select the carriers to quote, upload any documents that contain relevant data and click “Submit’’. Mulligan then logs into and produces draft quotes in each carrier portal, ready to review, edit and bind.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1013488/6f26d394-1c38-4f97-a17e-99c397e184db)

### **Policy Checking & Comparison**

Analyze quotes, binders or policies, compare across documents and identify gaps in coverage. Manually analyzing these documents used to take hours, if not days, and can now be done in minutes. This tool can be used to service existing customers, as well as to help close new ones by analyzing their existing policies and identifying areas of improvement.

Simply upload docs, view them side-by-side, chat with them and match them to checklists to identify gaps.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1013488/dbc87031-968d-4c02-8301-d77ee5cd94d3)

### **Proposals**

Generate beautiful, branded proposals using quotes, policies and binders in minutes. These documents can be produced in Mulligan’s own design format, or using a template provided by the agency. The end result is a document whose style, content and tone showcases the agency’s professionalism and thoroughness.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1013488/f393c554-a4f4-4485-8d9a-9e89bfe6248e)

### **Submissions**

Produce clean, complete and professional submissions to send to underwriters. Upload diverse documents such as loss runs, SOVs, vehicle and driver lists, and produce easily ingestible documents with just a few clicks. These submissions help portray the customer in the best possible light, and get processed by underwriters faster since they are well organized and easy to process.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1013488/66ba3d38-9f05-4ae9-a64f-fccefee61a2c)

### **Commissions**

Extract commissions from lengthy statements and transform them into a format expected by most popular Agency Management Systems such as Applied Epic, AMS360, EZLynx, Veruna and more. Furthermore, review the values in the commission statement to check if there’s an underpayment from the carrier, or to reconcile the books faster.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/1013488/218d7bc3-1aa4-45d6-abb8-0ddabd48c31f)

# **How to get started**

If you are an insurance agent working on commercial lines, or know someone who is, sign up at [usemulligan.com](http://usemulligan.com) for free and get started today. Mulligan has already been deployed across organizations of various sizes, and offers flexible pricing models that fit any budget.

launches.title: 🚀 Riveter API: Replace your entire scraper infrastructure with a single API
launches.tagline: Power your product with real data from the web.
launches.body:
We’re excited to launch our most requested feature: the **Riveter API**.

Web data is one of the biggest unlocks for what’s now possible with AI. But retrieving and structuring that data for your product or agents is far more complicated than it should be.

---

### **The Problem**

You need data from the web to equip your agents with more information or pipe structured data directly into your product.

But when it comes to web scraping, the gap between _idea_ and _working solution_ is huge.

* What starts as **“just a simple scraper” often turns into a patchwork of 5+ vendors** (SERP providers, proxy networks, headless browsers, scraper libraries, and infrastructure) leading to weeks or months of engineering effort.
* Timelines creep, **engineering costs rise, and maintaining scrapers becomes an ongoing burden**. All of this distracts your team from building your _core product._

https://youtu.be/1pFXQJExRGw

---

### **The Solution**

**Riveter** is the all-in-one web search agent. Configuration is simple — your team defines what data they need, and Riveter handles everything else.

* **Prompt-based configuration, tool selection, and custom formatting.** Tell Riveter what you need via a prompt, then select tools like web search, scraper, PDF reader, or image reader.
* **Everything built in.** SERP/search, proprietary scrapers, proxy management, and browser infrastructure are fully integrated, so you don’t have to build or connect multiple systems.
* **Structured, consistent output.** Apply custom tags or enums, specify date formats, or define JSON objects to get clean, predictable results every time.

The API routes data directly into your app — giving you real, grounded web data with minimal engineering overhead.

### **How It Works**

You can either **create a project in Riveter** to reference in your API request, or **configure all input and output fields directly in the API call.**

#### **Option 1: Creating an API request from a Riveter project**

Creating a project allows you to test and refine prompts and formatting before fetching data via the API.

**Best for:**

* Running recurring or long-term data collection
* Quickly testing and iterating on prompts and tools
* Structuring data that needs to be ingested by code

#### **Option 2: Configuring input/output fields directly in the API request**

On-the-fly configuration gives you the flexibility to change columns and prompts dynamically based on your inputs.

**Best for:**

* Giving AI agents access to create their own Riveter requests
* Handling variable outputs - e.g., running an initial request with Riveter, then defining attributes to evaluate your product or dataset on

### **Getting Started**

We can’t wait to see what you build with Riveter!

Head to[ ](https://riveterhq.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[**riveterhq.com**](http://riveterhq.com) and click **Get Started** — your first 500 searches are free!

Need a hand?[ Grab time here](https://riveterhq.com/contact?utm_source=chatgpt.com) and we’ll help you get set up.

**TL;DR:**

AutoAce is building the AI-native operating system for the $2T automotive industry, starting with voice agents. 

Our 24/7 AI agents book service and test-drive appointments, manage status updates, and run outbound campaigns such as recalls and service reminders. It integrates with any DMS/CRM/Scheduler system. 

[**https://youtu.be/pQLXABbouFg**](https://youtu.be/pQLXABbouFg)

### **The Problem**

The automotive service industry is crippled by operational inefficiency. Our research identified three core causes:

* **Antiquated technology:** Dealerships rely on legacy systems that are slow, outdated, and poorly integrated. Staff often revert to manual work with pen and paper.
* **Data silos and lack of visibility:** Parts and service departments operate separately, leading to missed updates, longer repair times, and limited visibility into vehicle status or parts availability.
* **Breakdown in customer communication:** High call volume and constant task switching cause missed calls, lost appointments, and frustrated customers. Advisors rarely have time to provide proactive updates, creating a cycle of more inbound calls and chaos.

### **Our Mission**

Our mission is to build the AI-native operating system for car dealerships. Dealerships run on fragmented systems and manual workflows that waste time and limit visibility. We believe AI can connect every part of the operation (from service and sales to parts and F&I) into one unified, intelligent platform.

Our immediate focus is reducing the administrative burden on service advisors, who are the front line of dealership operations. By automating repetitive tasks like answering phones, booking appointments, and updating customers, we help them focus on what actually matters: providing great service and driving revenue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94786&key=user_uploads/1322750/6dd5347b-66a0-4d34-9d60-85d2cca055dc)

### **Backstory**

It started on a highway between Boston and New York City.\
Our 2007 Toyota Sienna broke down on the way to an AI agent hackathon, and when we called towing and dealership service lines, no one picked up. After dozens of unanswered calls, we realized how broken communication in the automotive world really was.

We went back to campus, skipped class, and spent our days and nights inside dealerships. We shadowed advisors, picked up phones, and even did oil changes to understand the problem firsthand.\
After visiting more than 300 dealerships, we discovered the biggest bottleneck was human bandwidth. So we did what MIT students do best… we started coding inside the stores to fix it.

launches.title: Patent Watch - AI for patent infringements 📜
launches.tagline: Upload your patents, we find infringing products so you can sell licenses or litigate.
launches.body:
[**Patent Watch Launch Video**](https://youtu.be/9rLBsb_cX6E)

**Problem**

My co-founder, [**Andreas Stroe**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreasstroe) (also my brother), was doing research at Philips. He applied for 4 patents while he was there. After spending way too much time talking to the IP team, he realized that they hold 50,000 patents with a team of \~10 people to defend them.

A little background: a **patent costs** around **$50k** to obtain and maintain. $17k is non-negotiable, paid directly in fees. That means their **portfolio costs $850M** to **$2.5B**. The best part is that they, and pretty much every company in the world, rely on Googling competitors and sending salespeople to trade shows to hear about new products that could be infringing. This whole **portfolio** is **making** little to **no revenue.**

I guess you can see why we started building this right away.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94773&key=user_uploads/1250636/63eddfc4-bbda-4f22-b80e-7d4f0f15ced3)

_Can you tell we’re brothers?_

**Solution**

Super simplified to keep it easy to understand:

✅ We let companies upload their patents and get a list of claim charts showing what **products are infringing and how**, in 20 minutes instead of months.

✅ When companies get sued, they can **use us to find counter litigation**, since the person suing them is most likely infringing on some of the patents they hold too.

✅ The most common way to get these cases thrown out of court is by considering a patent invalid. That means there is some proof, like other patents, research papers, or products that existed before your patent was filed. We find all these and **confirm your patents will hold up in court.**

There is more, but you can consider this our “core”.

**Proof**

As you can imagine, pretty much everyone we work with has us under NDA. What I can tell you is that we work with private inventors up to Fortune and Global 500 companies.

**Why now?**

Of course, AI …

But also, the US Patent Office is tightening the rules for challenging patents in its review court. The director is being pickier about which cases get heard, and some evidence no longer counts.

🚨 It’s going to be a lot harder to attack a patent and a lot easier for owners to defend one🚨

**Ask**

If you hold patents and have more applications pending, you can probably use us.

Outside of that, we’d really appreciate intros to:

* Patent attorneys
* IP managers
* Licensing managers
* CTOs or heads of R&D at hardware, biotech, industrial, and large software companies

My email is [**alex@patentwatch.ai**](mailto:alex@patentwatch.ai) if you want to chat :)

_Thanks for reading!_

launches.title: Gerri - The AI Agent for Contract Redlines
launches.tagline: Get your contracts reviewed before you even realize they’re in your inbox
launches.body:
We’re Jake and Ben, co-founders of Common Paper.  We just launched Gerri, the AI agent for redlines. [Try it out here and get three contracts reviewed for free](https://commonpaper.com/product/ai-agent).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY

## Problem

Common Paper started by creating [standard agreements](https://commonpaper.com/standards/) that have been signed by more than 10,000 companies and used to close more than $100 million dollars in deals. We also make contract management software for customizing, signing, and tracking agreements with customers and partners.

As companies scale, more and more of their sales teams’ time is spent dealing with contract redlines from their customers.  After talking seeing the problem close up at countless companies, we found that most folks fall into one of two camps:

* Every contract redline gets sent to their attorney, which is expensive and adds delays
* Nothing gets sent to the attorney, and the founder, sales, ops, or other non-lawyer handles all redlines. This creates a significant risk when they don’t know what they don’t know about risks in contracts

A better approach is to have AI do a first read of each contract and then triage the redlines so that as much as possible is handled automatically, and then if anything remains, assign it to the right person. That’s what we built with Gerri.

## Solution

There are three ways contracts get into Gerri:

* Upload
* Forward an email with attachment
* Have Gerri scan your team’s inboxes for redlined contracts and automatically review them as they come in

Once Gerri gets a contract, it compares it to your playbook, which contains rules about what you will and won’t accept, how you respond to asks, comments to leave in the doc, etc. Gerri includes a demo playbook to help you get started, and you can chat or answer questions to have Gerri help you generate your own custom rules.

Gerri then either

* Responds with a clean contract that’s ready to send back to the other side.  Gerri automatically accepts, rejects, counter-proposes, and leaves comments for the other side.  
* Flags which redlines can’t be handled automatically, and notifies the right people for them to weigh in. For example, it might be your lawyer for indemnity issues, CS lead for renewal terms, and IT for special security procedures/certifications.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94771&key=user_uploads/71220/c61e5a05-75a4-4f95-a66d-cf4f618bb057)

Each time a human weighs in, they can make a decision for just this one case or have Gerri generate a rule to handle this decision going forward. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94771&key=user_uploads/71220/a1877eb9-5798-4ba5-8b31-eac429cd02b1)

The end result is your contracts get reviewed before you even realize they’re in your inbox, and deals close faster.

[Check out Gerri and get three contracts reviewed for free. ](https://commonpaper.com/product/ai-agent)

Hey YC! 👋

We’re Lihong & Bryan, former quant trader and developer, and we are building Freeport Markets (https://freeportmarkets.com) to make DeFi investing more accessible for all. 

**TL;DR:** Freeport helps you build a **diversified crypto portfolio** across quality assets, and access the most trusted and l**ucrative opportunities in DeFi** on one page, with one click.

**_Ask_**_:_ Try [freeportmarkets.com](http://freeportmarkets.com) (on desktop with hot wallet) and give us feedback! Connect us with student orgs or other groups who can help us with distribution. Our ICP are crypto-adjacent folks who keep most of their crypto on Robinhood/Coinbase. Check out our fun promo vid 👇https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TWZTB_r_jO4

### **❌ Problem**

Most investors’ crypto portfolios suffer from the follow issues: 

* **Leaving Yield on the Table:** Easy and safe 4-8% extra returns a year from staking / conservatively lending crypto assets that they already own.
* **Under-diversified:** Portfolios are often just BTC/ETH, which can underperform the crypto market. (No one buys a single stock as a “portfolio”; why a single token?)
* **Paying Unnecessary Fees:** Coinbase/Robinhood takes a massive cut out of yields, don’t let you lend/borrow at market rates, and have high trading fees.

**Net:** The best opportunities are in DeFi, but people miss out on common-sense optimization, true diversification, and lower fees, because DeFi is fragmented and confusing.

**💰Our Solution** 

* **Unify DeFi in One Place:** Freeport integrates trusted protocols on one page.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94762&key=user_uploads/2929506/f7aad792-d924-4859-aaeb-f992dfb18b5d)

* **Signal Over Noise:** We separate **treasure from trash** with a rigorous screening framework (see below) so nothing you buy here is a scam / rugpull.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94762&key=user_uploads/2929506/8cdbb09d-c8b3-4aef-98e1-e483ac16a014)

* **Yield on Resting Assets:** Put idle holdings to work in battle‑tested & audited opportunities with transparent sources of return.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94762&key=user_uploads/2929506/d4c8feb7-9589-48ab-9e8b-a5708f1d0899)

* **Real Diversification:** Allocate across chains, sectors, and risk factors in a single, simple flow using a framework supported by rigorous statistical inference (see below)

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94762&key=user_uploads/2929506/936963cf-a58a-48f1-8d6b-611da05e7433)

* **No Management Fees + Lowest Trading Costs:** We find the best possible path to route your order to minimize slippage and MEV (see below).

🏦**Our Mission**

Bring value and science-based “quantamental” investing to crypto, so people view it as the legitimate long-term asset that it is, not a day-trader’s playground. We combine rigorous screening and factor/sector diversification to filter noise and compound value over time.

**⛵Chart Your Course With Freeport** 

* Freeport is made for all long-term investors who want durable yield, smartly diversified portfolios, and explainable risk that drives compounding returns. 
* Get started today at [**freeportmarkets.com**](http://freeportmarkets.com), share us with friends who may be interested, and let us know about bugs / feature requests that you may have! 
* Reach us at [lihong.wang@freeportmarkets.com](mailto:lihong.wang@freeportmarkets.com) & [bryan.reed@freeportmarkets.com](mailto:bryan.reed@freeportmarkets.com).

 

### **⚙️Appendix: How It Works**

* [**Research-Backed Curation**](https://www.freeportmarkets.com/reference/Investable%20Universe%20Methodology.pdf)**:** To ensure that tokens that we support are legitimate, we operate inside only the top 250 by market cap and screen for real tradability. 
* [**Economic Diversification**](https://www.freeportmarkets.com/reference/Digital%20Asset%20Taxonomy.pdf)**:** We classify assets by their orthogonal drivers of returns: Settlement (execution/scaling vs. monetary), Infrastructure & Interoperability, DeFi/CeFi, Culture & Entertainment, DePIN & Resources, plus Stablecoins & RWA. 
* [**Factor Tilts**](https://www.freeportmarkets.com/reference/Quantitative%20Framework.pdf)**:** We track seven factors, market, size, value, momentum, growth, downside beta, liquidity, and prioritize momentum (best out-of-sample), with value & growth as corroborating signals; low-to-moderate correlations improve diversification.

We pair a disciplined universe + sector taxonomy with data-driven quantitative factors + human-expertise to construct recommendations and strategies that moves portfolios away from single-asset concentration toward repeatable, explainable, multi-factor returns, at [**freeportmarkets.com**](http://freeportmarkets.com)**.**
